About the job The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally. The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology. Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile. Responsibilities Developer Advocacy & Community Building
• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.
• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.
• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.
• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities. Technical Content & Enablement
• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.
• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.
• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.
• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions. Product Evangelism
• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.
• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.
• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.
• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.
• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.
• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.
• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.
• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners Thought Leadership
• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.
• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.
• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of professional software development experience.
• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.
• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.
• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.
• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.
• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.
• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.
• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.
• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)
• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems
• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement. Preferred
• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.
• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).
• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.
• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency
• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Tether e la tua futura carriera ### Descrizione Unisciti a Tether e contribuisci a plasmare il futuro della finanza digitale At Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, stiamo rivoluzionando il panorama finanziario globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende - dalle borse e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e alle bancomat - di integrare in modo fluido token garantiti da riserve su blockchain. Sfruttando il potere della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, a un costo inferiore del 10%. L'innovazione è il nostro pilastro, assicurando la trasparenza in ogni transazione. ### Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativi comprende la stablecoin più affidata al mondo, USDT, utilizzata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi di tokenizzazione di asset digitali pionieristici. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: La nostra soluzione per il potenziamento sostenibile ottimizza l'energia in eccesso per il mining del Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture di ultima generazione e geo-diverse. Tether Data: I nostri strumenti di avanzata tecnologia riducono i costi di infrastruttura e migliorano le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni come KEET, il nostro app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicuri e privati. Tether Education : La democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello consente alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig, promuovendo la crescita e l'opportunità globali. Tether Evolution : Al confine tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i limiti di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui l'innovazione e le capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e inediti. ### Perché unirti a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare il tuo segno nel settore fintech, questo è il tuo momento per collaborare con alcuni dei cervelli più brillanti, spingendo i limiti e stabilendo nuovi standard. Abbiamo cresciuto rapidamente, mantenuto la nostra struttura snella e assicurato il nostro posto di leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti abilità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire al più innovativo platform del pianeta, Tether è il posto giusto per te. Sei pronto a essere parte del futuro? ### Informazioni sul lavoro Come Filmmaker AI, utilizzerai strumenti di generazione di foto e video basati sull'intelligenza artificiale per concepire, creare e editare cortometraggi e video. Questi video saranno utilizzati per raccontare storie, presentare prodotti e portare le visioni di Tether e delle sue società affiliate alla vita. ### Responsabilità - Creare cortometraggi e video utilizzando strumenti di generazione di foto e video basati sull'intelligenza artificiale. - Editare e perfezionare il contenuto generato dall'intelligenza artificiale per produrre visuali di alta qualità e coinvolgenti. - Collaborare con i colleghi del team di marketing per sviluppare concetti di video per Tether e altre marche affiliate. - Assicurarsi che tutti i contenuti video siano in linea con le linee guida della marca e comunicino i messaggi chiave in modo efficace. - Restare aggiornato sulle ultime tecnologie e tecniche di filmmaking con AI, incorporando innovazioni nel proprio workflow. - Gestire più progetti con scadenze strette, assicurando la consegna tempestiva. - Sperimentare con formati, stili e effetti creativi per produrre contenuti unici e memorabili. ###
• Requisiti - Esperienza provata nella produzione e editing di video, con un portafoglio di lavoro solido. - Abilità nella generazione di video con strumenti AI (ad esempio, Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E o altri). - Esperto in software di editing video (ad esempio, Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). - Abilità di raccontare storie creative con un occhio attento per la composizione visiva e i dettagli. - Capacità di concepire e eseguire idee rapidamente utilizzando strumenti AI. - Familiarità con il marketing digitale e capacità di adattare il contenuto per piattaforme di social media. - Abilità di gestire progetti e organizzare il lavoro, con la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente e rispettare i tempi di consegna. - Passione per la tecnologia, il bitcoin e l'innovazione (un plus). ###
• Cosa offriamo - Compensazione competitiva. - Opportunità di lavorare con un team globale su progetti all'avanguardia. - Flessibilità di lavorare a distanza. - Accesso a strumenti e risorse di AI avanzati. - Un ambiente collaborativo in cui la tua creatività avrà un impatto diretto sulla narrazione della marca.

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
As an AI Filmmaker, you will leverage AI-based photo and video tools to conceptualize, create, and edit short films and videos. These videos will be used to tell stories, showcase products, and bring the visions of Tether and its affiliated companies to life. You’ll work closely within the marketing department to ensure that each video aligns with the brand’s message, tone, and visual style.

Responsibilities

• Create short films and videos using AI-driven photo and video generation tools.

• Edit and refine AI-generated content to produce high-quality, engaging visuals.

• Collaborate with the marketing team colleagues to develop video concepts for Tether, and other affiliated brands.

• Ensure all video content aligns with brand guidelines and communicates key messages effectively.

• Stay updated on the latest AI filmmaking tools and techniques, incorporating innovations into your workflow.

• Manage multiple projects with tight deadlines, ensuring timely delivery.

• Experiment with creative formats, styles, and effects to produce unique, memorable content.

• Proven experience in video production and editing, with a strong portfolio of work.

• Proficiency in AI video generation tools (e.g., Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E, or others).

• Expertise in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve).

• Creative storytelling skills with a keen eye for visual composition and detail.

• Ability to conceptualize and execute ideas quickly using AI tools.

• Familiarity with digital marketing and the ability to tailor content for social media platforms.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

• A passion for technology, bitcoin, and innovation is a plus.

What we offer

• Competitive compensation.

• Opportunity to work with a global team on cutting-edge projects.

• Flexibility to work remotely.

• Access to advanced AI tools and resources.

• A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative.

Tether und deine Zukunft ### Beschreibung Bist du bereit, Teil von Tether zu werden und den Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen zu gestalten? Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir revolutionieren den globalen Finanzmarkt. Unsere fortschrittlichen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Portfolios bis hin zu Zahlungssystemen und Bankautomaten - tokens mit garantierten Reserven auf der Blockchain zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Tether es dir, tokens digital zu speichern, zu senden und zu empfangen, sofort, sicher und global, zu einem Kostenrabatt von 10%. Innovation ist unser Leitprinzip, das Transparenz in jeder Transaktion gewährleistet. ### Innovieren mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produkt-Suite umfasst die weltweit vertrauenswürdigste Stablecoin, USDT, die von Hunderten Millionen Menschen weltweit verwendet wird, zusammen mit Pionierleistungen in der Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist nur der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Lösung für nachhaltige Leistungsoptimierung nutzt überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Methoden in modernen, geo-verteilten Strukturen. Tether Data: Unsere fortschrittlichen Technologien reduzieren die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit Lösungen wie KEET, unserem Flaggschiff-App, die die sichere und private Datenverteilung neu definiert. Tether Education : Die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu hochwertigem digitalen Lernen ermöglicht es Menschen, in digitalen und Gig-Ökonomien zu prosperieren, die Wachstum und globale Chancen fördert. Tether Evolution : Am Schnittpunkt von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial drücken wir die Grenzen dessen, was möglich ist, und schaffen einen Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten in neuen und kraftvollen Wegen zusammenfließen. ### Warum bist du Teil von uns? Unser Team ist eine globale Kraft aus Talenten, die von jedem Winkel der Welt aus arbeitet. Wenn du begeistert bist, deinen Einfluss im FinTech-Sektor zu hinterlassen, ist dies dein Moment, um mit einigen der brillantesten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu sprengen und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir haben schnell gewachsen, unsere Struktur erhalten und unseren Platz als Führer im Sektor gesichert. Wenn du ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch hast und bereit bist, zum innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für dich. Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu werden? ### Arbeitsinformationen Als AI-Filmmaker wirst du Tools für die generative Bild- und Videoproduktion basierend auf künstlicher Intelligenz verwenden, um Kurzfilme und Videos zu konzipieren, zu erstellen und zu bearbeiten. Diese Videos werden verwendet, um Geschichten zu erzählen, Produkte vorzustellen und die Visionen von Tether und seinen verbundenen Unternehmen in das Leben zu bringen. ###
• Aufgaben - Kurzfilme und Videos erstellen, indem man Tools für die generative Bild- und Videoproduktion basierend auf künstlicher Intelligenz verwendet. - Inhalte, die von der künstlichen Intelligenz generiert wurden, bearbeiten und vervollständigen, um hochwertige und fesselnde visuelle Inhalte zu produzieren. - Mit den Kollegen des Marketing-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Konzepte für Videos für Tether und andere Marken zu entwickeln. - Sichergestellt, dass alle Videoinhalte den Markenleitlinien entsprechen und die wichtigsten Botschaften effektiv übermitteln. - Sich auf dem Laufenden halten, was die neuesten Technologien und -Techniken der künstlichen Intelligenz-basierten Filmmaking sind, und Innovationen in den eigenen Workflow integrieren. - Mehrere Projekte mit engen Fristen verwalten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Termine eingehalten werden. - Experimentieren mit Formaten, Stilen und Effekten, um einzigartige und erinnerungswürdige Inhalte zu produzieren. ###
• Anforderungen - Erfahrung in der Produktion und Bearbeitung von Videos, mit einem soliden Portfolio. - Fähigkeit, Videos mit Tools für künstliche Intelligenz (z.B. Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E oder andere) zu generieren. - Experte in Software für die Videobearbeitung (z.B. Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
As an Associate on the Tether Capital team, you will own the data and reporting infrastructure that powers our investment platform. At the core of this role is responsibility for portfolio company reporting—ensuring that financial and operational data flows accurately and on schedule from our portfolio into our systems. You will be the steward of data integrity across our CRM and reporting tools. You will also support the team in managing inbound dealflow and coordinating deal execution, ensuring the pipeline stays clean and transactions move efficiently through close.

This is a high-leverage, detail-intensive role for someone who brings structure and discipline to a fast-moving investment platform. It is ideal for someone who is highly organized, comfortable operating with autonomy and energized by building and maintaining the infrastructure behind a growing investment portfolio

Responsibilities

• Portfolio Reporting and Data Management

• Own the accurate and timely entry of portfolio company data into the CRM, including financial and operational KPIs, valuation marks, ownership details and reporting updates.

• Collect, standardize, and reconcile periodic reporting from portfolio companies, flagging gaps, inconsistencies or missing data to the investment and finance teams.

• Produce and maintain internal portfolio reports and dashboards for the Tether Capital team and senior leadership, ensuring data integrity across all systems.

• Portfolio Support

• Serve as an operational touchpoint for portfolio companies, administering surveys and helping them tap into the firm's network, resources and internal expertise, while surfacing recurring founder needs to the team.

• Inbound Dealflow Management

• Serve as the first operational point of contact for inbound dealflow, triaging and logging opportunities to the appropriate members of the Tether Capital team.

• Maintain a clean, structured, and up-to-date pipeline in the CRM, ensuring every opportunity is properly categorized, tagged, and tracked through each stage.

• Deal Execution Support

• Support the investment team across the transaction lifecycle—coordinating documentation, tracking signature and closing checklists, ensuring workstreams stay on schedule through close.

• Liaise with internal teams and external counterparties to gather, organize, and maintain deal materials and closing documentation.

• Process and Systems Improvement

• Continuously improve the team's operating infrastructure—dealflow tracking, CRM hygiene and portfolio company reporting cadences.

• Identify and implement opportunities to automate or streamline manual processes, increasing the team's efficiency and reducing operational risk.

Requirements:

• Experience : 2–4 years in an operations, analyst, investment support or FP&A type role, ideally within venture capital or private equity

• Organization and Attention to Detail : Exceptional organizational skills and a near-obsessive attention to detail; you take ownership of data accuracy and process integrity.

• Systems and Tools : Hands-on proficiency with CRM and dealflow platforms as well as strong command of Excel/Google Sheets. Comfort learning and administering new tools quickly.

• Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to build, document and maintain repeatable processes, and to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without dropping details.

• Autonomy : Ability to work independently, take initiative and operate effectively in a remote, global, fast-moving environment.

It will be an asset if you have:

• Familiarity with venture/growth-stage investment workflows, portfolio reporting and valuation concepts.

• Working knowledge of stablecoins or blockchain ecosystems.

• Experience administering or implementing CRM systems and reporting dashboards.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated.

• All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
Be part of our Finance team: The Operations Associate/Senior associate will support the day-to-day operations of a multi-asset investment and treasury platform , with responsibilities spanning trade operations, reconciliations, digital asset workflows, and process automation. The role requires a highly detail-oriented individual with strong technical capability and experience operating in fast-paced financial markets environments.

Responsibilities
● Manage trade confirmations, settlements, and lifecycle events across multiple asset classes.
● Oversee wallet, custodian, and digital asset operational processes.
● Perform daily booking and reconciliation of securities positions, cash balances, and P&L across internal systems.
● Investigate and resolve trade breaks, settlement issues, and operational discrepancies with counterparties and custodians.
● Support operational controls relating to treasury, trading, and digital asset activities.
● Assist with audit requests, confirmations, and supporting documentation.
● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reporting.
● Build, enhance, and maintain operational workflows, internal tooling, and automation processes.
● Identify opportunities for process optimisation and operational scalability.
● Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and user guides.
● Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Preferred qualifications/Requirements:
● Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.
● 5+ years of operations experience preferably at a credit hedge fund or an asset management company
● experience in digital assets or blockchain ecosystem(good to have but not mandatory)
● Proficiency in Enfusion portfolio management system (not mandatory)
● Proficiency in Excel + VBA / Python
● Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
● Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.
● Strong understanding of trade lifecycles and settlement processes.
● Working hours: (New York hours): Between 14H00-10H00 UK time( mandatory)

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

● Surveiller les processus opérationnels relatifs au portefeuille, au dépositaire et aux biens numériques.
● Effectuer la réservation et le rapprochement quotidiens des positions de valeurs mobilières, des soldes de trésorerie et des P&L dans tous les systèmes internes.
● Étudier et résoudre les ruptures commerciales, les problèmes de règlement et les divergences opérationnelles avec les contreparties et les dépositaires.
● Appuyer les contrôles opérationnels relatifs aux activités liées à la trésorerie, au commerce et aux actifs numériques.
● Aider à répondre aux demandes de vérification, aux confirmations et aux documents justificatifs.
● Préparer des rapports opérationnels quotidiens, hebdomadaires et mensuels.
● Construire, améliorer et maintenir les flux de travail opérationnels, les outils internes et les processus d'automatisation.
● Identifier les possibilités d'optimisation des processus et d'évolutivité opérationnelle.
● Créer et tenir à jour la documentation technique, les procédures et les guides d'utilisation.
● Veiller au respect des contrôles internes, des politiques et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Qualités/exigences privilégiées :
● Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité ou domaine connexe.
● 5 ans et plus d'expérience opérationnelle de préférence dans un fonds de couverture de crédit ou une société de gestion d'actifs
● expérience dans les actifs numériques ou l'écosystème de blockchain (bien d'avoir mais pas obligatoire)
● Compétence du système de gestion de portefeuille d'Enfusion (non obligatoire)
● Compétence en Excel + VBA / Python
● Capacités exceptionnelles d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
● Excellente attention aux détails et à la communication.
● Une bonne compréhension du cycle de vie du commerce et des processus de règlement.
● Heures de travail: (heures de New York): Entre 14H00-10H00 heure du Royaume-Uni (obligatoire)

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro Questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che è autenticamente ossessionato dal prodotto. Avrete il ciclo di vita completo di un prodotto portafoglio crypto utilizzato a scala globale, dalla scrittura della prima storia utente alla spedizione della funzione per misurare ciò che ha effettivamente fatto. Impostare la roadmap, guidare ogni sprint, e essere la persona ogni ingegnere, progettista e stakeholder guarda a quando una decisione deve essere presa. Sarete anche la persona che cattura ciò che gli altri manca. Il PM che prospera qui legge ogni biglietto, traccia ogni dipendenza, pone la domanda scomoda prima che diventi un incidente di lancio, e mantiene cinque flussi di lavoro che si muovono simultaneamente senza perdere il filo su uno qualsiasi di loro. Se si preferisce un ruolo PM in cui si imposta la strategia e l'esecuzione del delegato, questo non è il giusto in forma. Se vuoi costruire qualcosa che spedisca a utenti reali, sposta i mercati e trasporta le tue impronte dal concetto alla produzione, vogliamo sentire da te. Responsabilità chiave:
• Sviluppo del prodotto e Roadmap: portare il ciclo di vita end-to-end del prodotto dall'ideazione e dai requisiti di raccolta all'analisi di consegna e post-lancio. Definire le storie degli utenti, i criteri di accettazione, eseguire la gestione del backlog e i flussi di lavoro per i team di sviluppo.
• Competenza Tecnica: Tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in requisiti di prodotto chiari e attuabili. Valutare le soluzioni tecniche e privilegiare le caratteristiche basate sulla fattibilità tecnica, impatto aziendale e valore del cliente.
• Condurre una vasta ricerca di mercato, compresa la scoperta del cliente per capire la proposizione di valore del nostro prodotto.
• Collaborazione trasversale: lavorare con sviluppatori, designer e altri stakeholder per raccogliere requisiti, convalidare e fornire soluzioni.
• Qualità e consegna: assicurarsi che le caratteristiche del prodotto siano consegnate in tempo e conformi agli standard di qualità; organizzare test e loop di feedback. Mandatory:
• 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti con almeno 3 anni in un ruolo di gestione dei prodotti tecnici.
• Esperienza passata nella costruzione o nella gestione di portafogli cripto con funzioni DeFi.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione per il collegamento di stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Un vero giocatore di squadra che costruisce la fiducia rapidamente, comunica con il candor, e rende le persone intorno a loro più efficace.
• Bias verso l'azione. Identificare ciò che deve cambiare, costruire il caso, e muoversi senza aspettare di essere chiesto.
• Prova capacità di guidare team interfunzionali e ottenere ingegneri, progettisti e stakeholder aziendali che si avvicinano allo stesso risultato allo stesso tempo.
• Allo stesso modo confortevole impostare la strategia e rotolare le maniche per eseguirlo. Non tradisci le cose e sparisci.
• Tracce in un ambiente ad alta pressione veloce. Fai il tuo lavoro migliore quando la posta in gioco è alta e la timeline è breve.
• Competenza nelle metodologie agili - Jira, Asana ecc.
• Forte comprensione di microservizi, sistemi peer-to-peer, javascript.
• Forte capacità organizzative per bilanciare più priorità in un ambiente remoto e veloce.
• Abilitato nella definizione, nel tracciamento e nel reporting sui KPI di prodotto per misurare il successo; l'esperienza nei test A/B o simili metodi di sperimentazione è un vantaggio. Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:
• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.
• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.
• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io
• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams.

• Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value.

• Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions.

• Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops.

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role.

• Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features.

• Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective.

• Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time.

• Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short.

• Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc.

• Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript.

• Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Vous posséderez le cycle de vie complet d'un produit de portefeuille crypto utilisé à l'échelle mondiale, de l'écriture de la première histoire utilisateur à l'expédition de la fonctionnalité à la mesure de ce qu'il a fait réellement. Vous définirez la feuille de route, piloterez chaque sprint et serez la personne à laquelle chaque ingénieur, concepteur et intervenant s'attend quand une décision doit être prise. Vous serez aussi la personne qui attrape ce que les autres manquent. Le PM qui prospère ici lit chaque ticket, suit chaque dépendance, pose la question inconfortable avant qu'il ne devienne un incident de lancement, et maintient cinq flux de travail se déplaçant simultanément sans perdre le fil sur l'un d'eux. Si vous préférez un rôle de PM où vous définissez la stratégie et délèguez l'exécution, ce n'est pas le bon ajustement. Si vous voulez construire quelque chose qui expédie à de vrais utilisateurs, déplace les marchés, et porte vos empreintes digitales du concept à la production, nous voulons entendre de vous. Principales responsabilités :
• Développement des produits et feuille de route : Diriger le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, de la collecte d'idées et d'exigences à la livraison et à l'analyse après lancement. Définir les histoires d'utilisateurs, les critères d'acceptation, gérer l'arriéré et les workflows pour les équipes de développement.
• Expertise technique: Traduire des concepts techniques complexes en exigences claires et réalisables. Évaluer les solutions techniques et prioriser les caractéristiques en fonction de la faisabilité technique, de l'impact commercial et de la valeur client.
• Mener une vaste étude de marché, y compris la découverte de clients pour comprendre la proposition de valeur de notre produit.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler avec les développeurs, les concepteurs et d'autres parties prenantes pour recueillir les exigences, valider et fournir des solutions.
• Qualité et livraison: S'assurer que les caractéristiques du produit sont livrées à temps et répondent aux normes de qualité; organiser des tests et des boucles de rétroaction. Obligatoire:
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de produits avec au moins 3 ans dans un rôle de gestion technique de produits.
• Expérience passée dans la construction ou la gestion de portefeuilles crypto avec des fonctionnalités DeFi.
• Excellentes compétences en communication pour rapprocher les acteurs techniques et non techniques.
• Un véritable joueur d'équipe qui construit la confiance rapidement, communique avec la candeur et rend les gens autour d'eux plus efficaces.
• Faux sur l'action. Vous identifiez ce qui doit changer, construisez le cas et bougez sans attendre d'être demandé.
• Capacité éprouvée de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et d'amener les ingénieurs, les concepteurs et les acteurs commerciaux à atteindre le même résultat en même temps.
• Aussi confortable de mettre en place la stratégie et de rouler vos manches pour l'exécuter. Tu ne laisses pas les choses disparaître.
• Thrives dans un environnement rapide et haute pression. Vous faites votre meilleur travail lorsque les enjeux sont élevés et le calendrier est court.
• Expertise en méthodologie agile - Jira, Asana, etc.
• Forte compréhension des microservices, systèmes peer-to-peer, javascript.
• Des compétences organisationnelles solides permettant d'équilibrer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement rapide et éloigné.
• Compétence dans la définition, le suivi et l'établissement de rapports sur les ICR produits pour mesurer le succès; l'expertise dans les tests A/B ou les méthodes d'expérimentation similaires est un atout. Information importante pour les candidats Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :
• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont listés sur notre page de carrière officielle : https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.
• Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.
• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ sether. io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams.

• Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value.

• Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions.

• Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops.

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role.

• Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features.

• Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective.

• Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time.

• Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short.

• Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc.

• Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript.

• Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Essere parte del nostro team Finance: The Operations Associate/Senior Associate supporterà le operazioni quotidiane di una piattaforma multi-asset di investimento e tesoreria, con responsabilità che spaziano dalle operazioni commerciali, dalle conciliazioni, dai flussi di attività digitali e dall'automazione dei processi. Descrizione Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Mansioni L'obiettivo di un Senior QA Engineer è garantire la qualità del prodotto, l'affidabilità e un'esperienza utente eccezionale attraverso una combinazione equilibrata di test manuali e automatizzati. Ciò comporta la progettazione e l'esecuzione di casi di test completi, l'esecuzione di test esplorativi e di regressione, l'identificazione e la documentazione di difetti, e garantire che i problemi siano adeguatamente monitorati e risolti. Gli ingegneri senior QA sviluppano e mantengono anche strutture di automazione scalabili, integrandole in processi di integrazione e distribuzione continui per ottenere una vasta copertura tra scenari funzionali, regressioni e prestazioni. Migliorando continuamente l'efficienza dei test e riducendo lo sforzo manuale, aiutano ad accelerare i cicli di rilascio senza compromettere la qualità. Concentrati sulla prevenzione dei difetti dal raggiungimento degli utenti finali, gli ingegneri senior QA collaborano strettamente con i team di sviluppo per mantenere elevati standard di usabilità, performance e affidabilità, fondendo la profondità di validazione manuale con la velocità e la coerenza dell'automazione per offrire un'esperienza di prodotto senza soluzione di continuità e affidabile. Responsabilità - Progettare ed eseguire prove: creare piani di prova dettagliati e ben strutturati e casi basati su requisiti di prodotto e criteri di accettazione. - Conduct Exploratory Testing: Indagare l'applicazione oltre i casi scritti per identificare casi di bordo, problemi di usabilità e comportamento inaspettato. - Identificare e documentare i difetti: registrare con precisione i problemi con i passaggi chiari per riprodurre, attesi contro i risultati effettivi e le prove rilevanti (screenshot, log). - Collaborare con i team di sviluppo: lavorare a stretto contatto con sviluppatori, product manager e designer per chiarire i requisiti e discutere le preoccupazioni di qualità. - Convalida Bug Fixes: Re-test difetti risolti per confermare che sono completamente fissi e non introdurre nuovi problemi. - Progettazione e sviluppo di casi di test automatizzati: costruire, mantenere e ottimizzare gli script di test automatizzati in base ai requisiti del prodotto e ai criteri di accettazione. - Creare e mantenere i framework di automazione dei test: sviluppare framework di automazione dei test scalabili, riutilizzabili e manutenbili che supportano test funzionali, regressioni e prestazioni. - Integrare l'automazione in CI/CD Pipelines: Collaborare con DevOps e i team di sviluppo per integrare test automatizzati in flussi di lavoro di integrazione e consegna continui. - Esegui test funzionali automatizzati: Eseguire suite di test automatizzate per convalidare che ogni funzione funziona come previsto e soddisfa gli standard di qualità. - Monitorare e analizzare i risultati dei test: Indagare i guasti dei test, identificare le cause radice e lavorare con i team di sviluppo per risolvere i difetti.
• Requisiti Mandato - Istruzione: Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo (o equivalente esperienza pratica). - Esperienza: - 5+ anni di esperienza nel Quality Assurance, tra cui test manuali e di automazione. - Esperienza dimostrata che definisce ed esegue strategie QA per sistemi software complessi. - 3+ anni di esperienza in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS - 3+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nell'implementazione dell'automazione di prova (ad esempio, utilizzando Selenium, Cypress, Playwright o equivalente). - 3+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione e realizzazione di test mobili nativi (ad esempio Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim o equivalente) - Conoscenza tecnica : - Forte comprensione delle metodologie QA, delle tecniche di progettazione dei test e delle pratiche SDLC/Agile/Scrum. - Esperienza pratica con le condotte CI/CD e le pratiche DevOps (ad esempio, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI). - Esperienza comprovata che integra test automatizzati nei flussi di lavoro di costruzione e distribuzione. - Proficienza nel QA e strumenti di tracciamento dei difetti (ad esempio, TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluenza). - Soft Skills: - Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder. - Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving. - Forte capacità auto-organizzative e adattabilità. Lavorare efficacemente in ambienti agili e veloci, e regolare a cambiare priorità, requisiti e tempi di consegna. - Lingua: competenza in inglese (spoken e scritto). Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
The goal of a Senior QA Engineer is to ensure product quality, reliability, and an exceptional user experience through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing. This involves designing and executing comprehensive test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, identifying and documenting defects, and ensuring issues are properly tracked and resolved.

Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality.

Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience.

Responsibilities

• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.

• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).

• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.

• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.

• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.

• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.

• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.

• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

Mandatory

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.

• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS

• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).

• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)

• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.

• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.

• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.

• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.

• Technical Knowledge :

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.

• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).

• Soft Skills :

• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.

• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred

• Certifications : ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent QA certification.

• Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured).

• Understanding of system architecture and software integration testing.

• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling).

• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure software testing practices.

• Experience with test data management and environment configuration.

• Knowledge of performance, load, and security testing principles.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

En améliorant continuellement l'efficacité des tests et en réduisant l'effort manuel, ils contribuent à accélérer les cycles de libération sans compromettre la qualité. Concentré sur la prévention des défauts pour atteindre les utilisateurs finaux, Senior QA Engineers collabore étroitement avec les équipes de développement pour maintenir des normes élevées d'utilisation, de performance et de fiabilité, en combinant la profondeur de la validation manuelle avec la rapidité et la cohérence de l'automatisation pour offrir une expérience de produit transparente et fiable. Responsabilità - Design and Execute Test Cases : Créez des plans d'essais détaillés et bien structurés et des cas basés sur les exigences du produit et les critères d'acceptation. - Conduct Exploratory Testing : Étudier l'application au-delà des cas scénarisés pour identifier les cas bord, les problèmes d'utilisation et le comportement inattendu. - Identifier et documenter les défauts : enregistrer avec précision les problèmes avec des étapes claires pour reproduire, les résultats attendus vs. réels, et les preuves pertinentes (screenshots, journaux). - Collaborer avec les équipes de développement : Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, les gestionnaires de produits et les concepteurs pour clarifier les exigences et discuter des préoccupations de qualité. - Valider les corrections de bogues : Re-test résolu les défauts pour confirmer qu'ils sont entièrement corrigés et ne pas introduire de nouveaux problèmes. - Conception et développement de boîtiers d'essai automatisés : Construisez, maintenez et optimisez des scripts d'essai automatisés en fonction des exigences du produit et des critères d'acceptation. - Créer et maintenir des cadres d'automatisation des essais : Développer des cadres d'automatisation des essais évolutives, réutilisables et durables qui soutiennent les tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance. - Intégrer l'automatisation dans les pipelines CI/CD : Collaborer avec DevOps et les équipes de développement pour intégrer les tests automatisés dans les flux de travail continus d'intégration et de livraison. - Exécuter des tests fonctionnels automatisés : Exécuter des tests automatisés pour valider que chaque fonction fonctionne comme prévu et répond aux normes de qualité. - Surveiller et analyser les résultats des tests : Étudier les échecs des tests, identifier les causes profondes et travailler avec les équipes de développement pour résoudre les défauts.
• Requisiti Obligatoire - Éducation : Baccalauréat en informatique, technologie de l'information, génie, ou un domaine connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente). - Expérience : - 5 ans et plus d'expérience en assurance qualité, y compris les tests manuels et d'automatisation. - Expérience démontrée définissant et exécutant des stratégies d'AQ pour des systèmes logiciels complexes. - 3+ ans d'expérience en JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS - 3+ ans d'expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de tests d'automatisation (par exemple, en utilisant Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, ou équivalent). - 3 ans et plus d'expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d'automatisations de tests mobiles natives (par exemple Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim ou équivalent) - Expertise dans la définition et la mise en oeuvre de plans de tests, de cadres d'automatisation et de mesures de qualité. - Fortes compétences en collaboration pour aligner les efforts de test sur le développement, les DevOps et la gestion des produits. - Capacité d'évaluer de façon critique les exigences de qualité, en assurant la clarté, la testabilité et l'exhaustivité. - Capacité démontrée de déterminer les risques de libération, d'accroître les préoccupations et de recommander des décisions d'exclusion lorsque les normes de qualité ou les critères de libération ne sont pas respectés. - Connaissances techniques : - Bonne compréhension des méthodologies d'AQ, des techniques de conception des essais et des pratiques SDLC/Agile/Scrum. - Expérience pratique des pipelines CI/CD et des pratiques DevOps (p. ex., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI). - Expérience éprouvée intégrant des tests automatisés dans les flux de travail de construction et de déploiement. - Compétence en QA et en outils de repérage des défauts (p. ex. TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence). - Compétences souples : - Compétences solides en communication et en gestion des intervenants. - Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. - Fortes compétences auto-organisationnelles et adaptabilité. Travailler efficacement dans des environnements agiles et rapides, et s'adapter à l'évolution des priorités, des exigences et des délais de livraison. - Langue : Connaissance de l'anglais (parlé et écrit). Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards.
