If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The goal of a Senior QA Engineer is to ensure product quality, reliability, and an exceptional user experience through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing. This involves designing and executing comprehensive test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, identifying and documenting defects, and ensuring issues are properly tracked and resolved. Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality. Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience. Responsibilities
• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.
• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.
• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).
• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.
• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.
• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.
• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.
• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.
• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.
• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects. Mandatory
• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
• Experience:
• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.
• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.
• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS
• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).
• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)
• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.
• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.
• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.
• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.
• Technical Knowledge :
• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.
• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).
• Soft Skills :
• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.
• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written). Preferred
• Certifications : ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent QA certification.
• Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured).
• Understanding of system architecture and software integration testing.
• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling).
• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure software testing practices.
• Experience with test data management and environment configuration.
• Knowledge of performance, load, and security testing principles. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality. Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience. Responsibilities
• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.
• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.
• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).
• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.
• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.
• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.
• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.
• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.
• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.
• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects. Mandatory
• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
• Experience:
• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.
• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.
• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS
• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).
• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)
• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.
• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.
• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.
• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.
• Technical Knowledge :
• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.
• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).
• Soft Skills :
• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.
• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written). Preferred
• Certifications : ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent QA certification.
• Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured).
• Understanding of system architecture and software integration testing.
• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling).
• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure software testing practices.
• Experience with test data management and environment configuration.
• Knowledge of performance, load, and security testing principles. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere i gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali pionieristici.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma di media intelligence altamente scalabile che elabora, analizza e bandiere contenuti potenzialmente problematici su grandi volumi di video, audio, immagine e testo. La piattaforma alimenta i flussi di lavoro di sicurezza dei contenuti per i prodotti Tether Data, tra cui Keet, e deve operare in modo affidabile in scala tra lingue, formati e tipi di contenuti diversi.
In qualità di Staff ML Systems Engineer, possederai il nucleo di questa piattaforma - dalle tubazioni di elaborazione ingestione e asincrona attraverso l'integrazione del modello AI/ML, l'ottimizzazione delle inferenze, la ricerca vettoriale e la generazione di report strutturati. Questo non è un ruolo di ricerca e non è un ruolo di ingegneria rapida. Si tratta di un ruolo di ingegneria di produzione in cui i modelli sono un componente di un sistema più ampio che si è responsabili di rendere veloce, affidabile, conveniente e manutenbile.
Sarete il proprietario tecnico senior del backend dell'intelligence dei media. Ciò significa che si definisce l'architettura, fare le chiamate di scambio duro, mentore altri ingegneri, e portare la responsabilità per il sistema in produzione. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con la leadership ingegneristica e collaborare con ricercatori ML, ingegneri di dati e team di prodotto per fornire una piattaforma che fornisce risultati azionabili e timestamp ai recensori umani in scala.

responsabilità
Backend Architettura e Proprietà del sistema

• Progettare e gestire servizi di backend scalabili per l'ingestione dei media, la lavorazione e la generazione dei report - puliti, ben testati e costruiti per scalare orizzontale dal primo giorno

• Contratti propri API, modelli di dati e modelli di storage per attività multimediali, processi di elaborazione, uscite di modelli, embeddings e percorsi di audit

• Costruire canali di elaborazione asincrona ad alto rendimento per video, audio, immagine e testo utilizzando code e modelli basati su eventi (SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub, o equivalenti)

• Esecuzione asincrona affidabile con retries, idempotency, file di letter morti, gestione della backpressure e degradazione aggraziata

Integrazione AI/ML & Model Workflows

• Integrare e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di inferenza AI/ML all'interno del backend - embedding pipelines, modelli multimodali, OCR, discorso-to-text, analisi della scena e classificatori visivi

• Infrastruttura di manutenzione del proprio modello: strategie di batching, tuning di concurrency, comportamento di riscaldamento, gestione timeout, autoscaling e utilizzo GPU

• Applicare tecniche di ottimizzazione del modello pratico - quantizzazione, distillazione, batching, caching, routing a modelli più piccoli se del caso - per colpire latenza, throughput e obiettivi di costo su hardware constrained

• Benchmark e valutare i modelli candidati utilizzando metriche rilevanti per il dominio, non solo classifiche standard. Impostare le soglie operative utilizzando metodi di calibrazione data-driven e documentare il razionale

Ottimizzazione del modello e delle prestazioni

• Ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di inferenza AI/ML per la latenza, il throughput, l'affidabilità e il costo in entrambi i percorsi di elaborazione in tempo reale e batch.

• Lavorare con sistemi di manutenzione del modello come vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, o servizi di inferenza personalizzati per migliorare il batching, concurrency, comportamento di riscaldamento, gestione timeout, autoscaling e utilizzo GPU.

• Valutare e applicare tecniche di ottimizzazione dei modelli pratici come quantizzazione, distillazione dei modelli, batching, caching, ottimizzazione rapida e routing a modelli più piccoli o più economici, se del caso.

• Progettazione e manutenzione di sistemi di ricerca e indicizzazione vettoriale utilizzando tecnologie come Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elastic Vectors, FAISS, pgvector, o strumenti simili.

• Costruire flussi di lavoro di recupero che supportano la ricerca semantica, la somiglianza corrispondente, il rilevamento duplicato, la scoperta dei media e la ricerca dei metadati strutturati.

• Monitorare le prestazioni del modello e del sistema in produzione, tra cui latenza API, la profondità della coda, il tempo di elaborazione, i tassi di errore del modello, l'utilizzo della GPU, le distribuzioni della fiducia, i segnali della deriva e il costo per prodotto elaborato. Ricerca, Indicizzazione e recupero dati

Infrastrutture, Affidabilità e Osservabilità

• Distribuire e gestire i sistemi su piattaforme cloud AWS, GCP, Azure o equivalenti, inclusi sistemi di calcolo, storage, networking, code, infrastruttura di monitoraggio e monitoraggio.

• Assicurare l'affidabilità del sistema attraverso logging, metriche, tracciamento, allerta, dashboard, runbook operativi e best practice di risposta agli incidenti.

Collaborazione e leadership ingegneristica

• Mentor junior e mid-level ingegneri attraverso le recensioni dei codici, le discussioni di progettazione e l'accoppiamento hands-on

• Guidare le decisioni architettoniche e aumentare la qualità dell'ingegneria attraverso il backend, l'infrastruttura e il lavoro di integrazione ML

• Traduci i requisiti ambigui del prodotto in chiari materiali tecnici con criteri di successo definiti

Queste tre capacità non sono negoziabili. Si prega di non applicare se non si può parlare a tutti e tre con esempi specifici e numeri reali.

• Ottimizzazione del modello per hardware limitato. Hai implementato un modello ML (qualsiasi modalità) su un server di inferenza limitato alla memoria e migliorato le sue prestazioni in produzione. Hai esperienza pratica con almeno due di: quantizzazione (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF, o bitsandbytes), messa a punto di strategia di batching, ottimizzazione KV-cache, distillazione della conoscenza, o configurazione del framework di servizio (vLLM, Triton, TGI, o equivalente). È possibile citare specifici prima/dopo latenza, il throughput, o numeri di memoria da quel lavoro.

• Proprietà delle tubazioni asinc. Hai posseduto un processo multimediale asincastro o un processo di inferenza ML fine a fine - tra cui la progettazione della coda, la gestione dei guasti dei lavoratori, idempotency, la logica di riprovazione, le code di letter morti, e uno strato di osservabilità. Capisci cosa succede sotto la pressione e cosa si rompe prima.

• Valutazione e rigore di calibrazione. Hai impostato le soglie operative del modello utilizzando metodi data-driven - curve di precisione/recall, metriche ponderate, o benchmark specifici del dominio - non intuizione o prova ed errore. È possibile spiegare i tradeoff falsi positivi e falsi negativi di un classificatore in lingua normale a uno stakeholder non tecnico.

Requisiti aggiuntivi:

• 8+ anni di esperienza di backend engineering building sistemi distribuiti scalabili, datadotti o servizi di elaborazione media

• 4+ anni di esperienza di integrazione ML pratica nella produzione (modello API, embedding pipelines, OCR, discorso-testo, analisi video/immagine, o inferenza multimodale)

• Forte competenza Python; profonda comprensione del design RESTful API e dei modelli di elaborazione asincrona

• Esperienza con database SQL e NoSQL, progettazione degli schemi e modellazione dei dati

• Esperienza di distribuzione e sistemi operativi su AWS, GCP o Azure

Preferito:

• Esperienza con canali di elaborazione video/immagine

• Familiarità con i trasformatori HuggingFace, PyTorch e l'ecosistema modello open source

• Lavoro prioritario sulla moderazione dei contenuti, sulla fiducia e sulla sicurezza o sui sistemi di intelligenza dei media

• Esperienza con modelli multilingue o condutture di contenuti multilingue

• Contributi a progetti ML o infrastruttura open source

Progettazione e architettura del sistema

• Preferita comprensione dei sistemi distribuiti, modelli di scaling e ingegneria delle prestazioni

• Capacità di progettare architetture modulari, manutenbili ed efficienti

• Esperienza con la versione API, la modularizzazione e la progettazione di flussi di lavoro lunghi

• Comprensione dei colli di bottiglia delle prestazioni e dei modelli backend a bassa latenza

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite e-mail e piattaforme ufficiali.

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalarlo immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We are building a highly scalable media intelligence platform that processes, analyzes, and flags potentially problematic content across large volumes of video, audio, image, and text. The platform powers content safety workflows for Tether Data products, including Keet, and must operate reliably at scale across diverse languages, formats, and content types.
As a Staff ML Systems Engineer, you will own the core of this platform - from ingestion and async processing pipelines through AI/ML model integration, inference optimization, vector search, and structured report generation. This is not a research role and it is not a prompt-engineering role. It is a production engineering role where the models are one component of a larger system that you are responsible for making fast, reliable, cost-efficient, and maintainable.
You will be the senior technical owner of the media intelligence backend. That means you define the architecture, make the hard tradeoff calls, mentor other engineers, and carry responsibility for the system in production. You will work closely with engineering leadership and collaborate with ML researchers, data engineers, and product teams to deliver a platform that provides actionable, timestamped findings to human reviewers at scale.

Responsibilities
Backend Architecture & System Ownership

• Design and operate scalable backend services for media ingestion, processing, and report generation - clean, well-tested, and built for horizontal scaling from day one

• Own API contracts, data models, and storage patterns for media assets, processing jobs, model outputs, embeddings, and audit trails

• Build high-throughput async processing pipelines for video, audio, image, and text using queues and event-driven patterns (SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent)

• Implement reliable asynchronous processing with retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, backpressure handling, and graceful degradation

AI/ML Integration & Model Workflows

• Integrate and optimize AI/ML inference workflows within the backend - embedding pipelines, multimodal models, OCR, speech-to-text, scene analysis, and visual classifiers

• Own model-serving infrastructure: batching strategies, concurrency tuning, warmup behavior, timeout handling, autoscaling, and GPU utilization

• Apply practical model optimization techniques - quantization, distillation, batching, caching, routing to smaller models where appropriate - to hit latency, throughput, and cost targets on constrained hardware

• Benchmark and evaluate candidate models using domain-relevant metrics, not just standard leaderboards. Set operating thresholds using data-driven calibration methods and document the rationale

Model Serving & Performance Optimization

• Optimize AI/ML inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost across both real-time and batch-processing paths.

• Work with model-serving systems such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or custom inference services to improve batching, concurrency, warmup behavior, timeout handling, autoscaling, and GPU utilization.

• Evaluate and apply practical model optimization techniques such as quantization, model distillation, batching, caching, prompt optimization, and routing to smaller or cheaper models where appropriate.

• Design and maintain vector search and indexing systems using technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elastic Vectors, FAISS, pgvector, or similar tools.

• Build retrieval workflows that support semantic search, similarity matching, duplicate detection, media discovery, and structured metadata search.

• Monitor model and system performance in production, including API latency, queue depth, processing time, model error rates, GPU utilization, confidence distributions, drift signals, and cost per processed item.Search, Indexing & Data Retrieval

Infrastructure, Reliability & Observability

• Deploy and operate systems on AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent cloud platforms, including compute, storage, networking, queues, model-serving infrastructure, and monitoring systems.

• Ensure system reliability through logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards, operational runbooks, and incident-response best practices.

Collaboration & Engineering Leadership

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on pairing

• Drive architectural decisions and raise engineering quality across backend, infrastructure, and ML integration work

• Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear technical deliverables with defined success criteria

These three capabilities are non-negotiable . Please do not apply if you cannot speak to all three with specific examples and real numbers.

• Model optimization for constrained hardware. You have deployed an ML model (any modality) on a memory-constrained inference server and improved its performance in production. You have hands-on experience with at least two of: quantization (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF, or bitsandbytes), batching strategy tuning, KV-cache optimization, knowledge distillation, or serving framework configuration (vLLM, Triton, TGI, or equivalent). You can cite specific before/after latency, throughput, or memory numbers from that work.

• Production async pipeline ownership. You have owned an async media-processing or ML inference pipeline end to end - including queue design, worker failure handling, idempotency, retry logic, dead-letter queues, and an observability layer. You understand what happens under backpressure and what breaks first.

• Evaluation and calibration rigor. You have set model operating thresholds using data-driven methods - precision/recall curves, cost-weighted metrics, or domain-specific benchmarks - not intuition or trial and error. You can explain the false-positive and false-negative tradeoffs of a classifier in plain language to a non-technical stakeholder.

Additional requirements:

• 8+ years of backend engineering experience building scalable distributed systems, data pipelines, or media processing services

• 4+ years of hands-on ML integration experience in production (model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, video/image analysis, or multimodal inference)

• Strong Python proficiency; deep understanding of RESTful API design and async processing patterns

• Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, schema design, and data modeling

• Experience deploying and operating systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure

Preferred:

• Experience with video/image processing pipelines

• Familiarity with HuggingFace transformers, PyTorch, and the open-source model ecosystem

• Prior work on content moderation, trust and safety, or media intelligence systems

• Experience with multilingual models or multilingual content pipelines

• Contributions to open-source ML or infrastructure projects

System Design & Architecture

• Preferred understanding of distributed systems, scaling patterns, and performance engineering

• Ability to design modular, maintainable, and efficient architectures

• Experience with API versioning, modularization, and designing long-running workflows

• Understanding of performance bottlenecks and low-latency backend patterns

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Wir bauen eine hochskalierbare Media Intelligence-Plattform auf, die potenziell problematische Inhalte in großen Mengen von Video, Audio, Bild und Text verarbeitet, analysiert und markiert. Die Plattform unterstützt Content-Sicherheits-Workflows für Tether Data-Produkte, einschließlich Keet, und muss zuverlässig in verschiedenen Sprachen, Formaten und Inhaltstypen skaliert arbeiten.
Als Staff ML Systems Engineer besitzen Sie den Kern dieser Plattform - von Ingestion- und Async-Verarbeitungspipelines über AI / ML-Modellintegration, Inferenzoptimierung, Vektorsuche und strukturierte Berichtsgenerierung. Dies ist keine Rolle der Forschung und es ist keine prompt-engineering Rolle. Es ist eine produktionstechnische Rolle, bei der die Modelle eine Komponente eines größeren Systems sind, für das Sie schnell, zuverlässig, kosteneffizient und wartbar sind.
Sie werden der leitende technische Eigentümer des Media Intelligence Backends sein. Das heißt, Sie definieren die Architektur, machen die harten Kompromisse, betreuen andere Ingenieure und tragen die Verantwortung für das System in der Produktion. Sie arbeiten eng mit der Engineering-Führung zusammen und arbeiten mit ML-Forschern, Dateningenieuren und Produktteams zusammen, um eine Plattform bereitzustellen, die menschlichen Reviewern aussagekräftige, zeitgestempelte Ergebnisse bietet.

Zuständigkeiten
Backend Architektur & Systembesitz

• Design und Betrieb skalierbarer Backend-Services für Medienaufnahme, -verarbeitung und Berichtsgenerierung - sauber, gut getestet und für die horizontale Skalierung vom ersten Tag an konzipiert

• Eigene API-Verträge, Datenmodelle und Speichermuster für Media Assets, Processing Jobs, Model Outputs, Embeddings und Audit Trails

• Erstellen Sie hochdurchsatzfähige Async-Verarbeitungspipelines für Video, Audio, Bild und Text mit Warteschlangen und ereignisgesteuerten Mustern (SQS, Kafka, Pub / Sub oder gleichwertig)

• Implementieren Sie eine zuverlässige asynchrone Verarbeitung mit Retries, Idempotenz, Dead-Buchstaben-Warteschlangen, Rückdruckhandling und anmutiger Degradation

AI/ML Integration & Model Workflows

• Integrieren und optimieren Sie AI/ML-Inferenz-Workflows im Backend - Einbetten von Pipelines, multimodalen Modellen, OCR, Sprache-zu-Text, Szenenanalyse und visuelle Klassifikatoren

• Eigene modellführende Infrastruktur: Batching-Strategien, Concurrency-Tuning, Warmup-Verhalten, Timeout-Handling, Autoscaling und GPU-Auslastung

• Anwendung praktischer Modelloptimierungstechniken - Quantisierung, Destillation, Batching, Caching, gegebenenfalls Routing zu kleineren Modellen -, um Latenz-, Durchsatz- und Kostenziele auf eingeschränkter Hardware zu erreichen

• Benchmark und Bewertung von Kandidatenmodellen mit domänenrelevanten Metriken, nicht nur mit Standard-Bestenlisten. Setzen Sie Betriebsschwellen mit datengesteuerten Kalibriermethoden und dokumentieren Sie die Gründe

Model Serving & Performance Optimierung

• Optimieren Sie AI/ML-Inferenz-Workflows für Latenz, Durchsatz, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosten über Echtzeit- und Batch-Verarbeitungspfade.

• Arbeiten Sie mit modellführenden Systemen wie vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI oder benutzerdefinierten Inferenzdiensten, um Batching, Parallelität, Aufwärmverhalten, Timeout-Handling, Autoskalierung und GPU-Auslastung zu verbessern.

• Bewerten und wenden Sie praktische Modelloptimierungstechniken wie Quantisierung, Modelldestillation, Batching, Caching, prompte Optimierung und Routing zu kleineren oder billigeren Modellen an, wo dies angebracht ist.

• Design und Wartung von Vektorsuch- und Indexierungssystemen mit Technologien wie Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elastic Vectors, FAISS, pgvector oder ähnlichen Tools.

• Erstellen Sie Retrieval-Workflows, die semantische Suche, Ähnlichkeitsabgleich, doppelte Erkennung, Medienerkennung und strukturierte Metadatensuche unterstützen.

• Überwachen Sie die Modell- und Systemleistung in der Produktion, einschließlich API-Latenz, Warteschlangentiefe, Verarbeitungszeit, Modellfehlerraten, GPU-Auslastung, Konfidenzverteilungen, Driftsignale und Kosten pro verarbeitetem Artikel. Suche, Indexierung und Datenabruf

Infrastruktur, Zuverlässigkeit & Beobachtung

• Bereitstellen und Betreiben von Systemen auf AWS, GCP, Azure oder gleichwertigen Cloud-Plattformen, einschließlich Compute, Storage, Networking, Warteschlangen, Modell-Service-Infrastruktur und Überwachungssysteme.

• Gewährleistung der Systemzuverlässigkeit durch Protokollierung, Metriken, Nachverfolgung, Alarmierung, Dashboards, Betriebslaufbücher und Best Practices für die Reaktion auf Vorfälle.

Zusammenarbeit & Engineering Leadership

• Mentor Junior- und Mid-Level-Ingenieure durch Code-Reviews, Design-Diskussionen und praktische Kopplung

• Führen Sie architektonische Entscheidungen voran und erhöhen Sie die technische Qualität bei Backend-, Infrastruktur- und ML-Integrationsarbeiten

• Mehrdeutige Produktanforderungen in klare technische Ergebnisse mit definierten Erfolgskriterien übersetzen

Diese drei Fähigkeiten sind nicht verhandelbar. Bitte wenden sie sich nicht an, wenn sie nicht mit allen dreien mit spezifischen beispielen und reellen zahlen sprechen können.

• Modelloptimierung für eingeschränkte Hardware. Sie haben ein ML-Modell (eine beliebige Modalität) auf einem speicherbeschränkten Inferenzserver bereitgestellt und dessen Leistung in der Produktion verbessert. Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei: Quantisierung (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF oder Bitsandbyte), Batching-Strategie-Tuning, KV-Cache-Optimierung, Wissensdestillation oder Serving-Framework-Konfiguration (vLLM, Triton, TGI oder gleichwertig). Sie können bestimmte Vorher-Nachher-Latenz-, Durchsatz- oder Speichernummern aus dieser Arbeit angeben.

• Produktion async Pipeline Eigentum. Sie haben eine asynchrone Medienverarbeitungs- oder ML-Inferenz-Pipeline von Ende zu Ende - einschließlich Warteschlangendesign, Worker Failure Handling, Idempotenz, Retry-Logik, Dead-Buchstaben-Warteschlangen und einer Beobachtbarkeitsschicht. Sie verstehen, was unter rückdruck passiert und was zuerst bricht.

• Bewertungs- und Kalibriergenauigkeit. Sie haben Modellbetriebsschwellen mit datengesteuerten Methoden festgelegt - Präzisions- / Rückrufkurven, kostengewichtete Metriken oder domänenspezifische Benchmarks - nicht Intuition oder Versuch und Irrtum. Sie können die falsch-positiven und falsch-negativen Kompromisse eines Klassifikators in einfacher Sprache einem nicht-technischen Stakeholder erklären.

Zusätzliche Anforderungen:

• 8+ Jahre Backend Engineering Erfahrung beim Aufbau skalierbarer verteilter Systeme, Datenpipelines oder Medienverarbeitungsdienste

• 4+ Jahre praktische ML-Integrationserfahrung in der Produktion (Modell-APIs, Einbettungs-Pipelines, OCR, Sprach-zu-Text, Video-/Bildanalyse oder multimodale Inferenz)

• Starke Python-Kenntnisse; tiefes Verständnis von RESTful API Design und async Verarbeitungsmuster

• Erfahrung mit SQL- und NoSQL-Datenbanken, Schemadesign und Datenmodellierung

• Erleben Sie die Bereitstellung und den Einsatz von Betriebssystemen auf AWS, GCP oder Azure

Bevorzugt:

• Erfahrung mit Video-/Bildverarbeitungspipelines

• Vertrautheit mit HuggingFace Transformatoren, PyTorch und dem Open-Source-Modell-Ökosystem

• Vorherige Arbeiten zu Content Moderation, Trust and Safety oder Media Intelligence Systemen

• Erfahrung mit mehrsprachigen Modellen oder mehrsprachigen Content-Pipelines

• Beiträge zu Open-Source-ML- oder Infrastrukturprojekten

System Design & Architektur

• Bevorzugtes Verständnis von verteilten Systemen, Skalierungsmustern und Performance Engineering

• Fähigkeit, modulare, wartbare und effiziente Architekturen zu entwerfen

• Erfahrung mit API-Versionierung, Modularisierung und Design von lang laufenden Workflows

• Verständnis von Leistungsengpässen und Backend-Mustern mit niedriger Latenz

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Im Zweifelsfall können Sie sich über unsere offizielle Website informieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Joindre Tether et façonner l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises – des échanges et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets – d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début :
Tether Power: moteur de la croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Nous construisons une plateforme d'intelligence médiatique hautement évolutive qui traite, analyse et affiche des contenus potentiellement problématiques sur de grands volumes de vidéo, d'audio, d'image et de texte. La plate-forme alimente les workflows de sécurité de contenu pour les produits Tether Data, y compris Keet, et doit fonctionner de manière fiable à l'échelle de différents langages, formats et types de contenu.
En tant qu'ingénieur des systèmes ML du personnel, vous posséderez le noyau de cette plateforme - des pipelines de traitement de l'ingestion et de l'async par l'intégration de modèles AI/ML, l'optimisation de l'inférence, la recherche vectorielle et la génération structurée de rapports. Ce n'est pas un rôle de recherche et ce n'est pas un rôle d'ingénierie rapide. C'est un rôle d'ingénierie de production où les modèles sont une composante d'un système plus grand que vous êtes responsable de rendre rapide, fiable, rentable, et durable.
Vous serez le principal propriétaire technique du moteur de renseignement médiatique. Cela signifie que vous définissez l'architecture, faites les appels de compromis difficiles, mentorez d'autres ingénieurs, et portez la responsabilité du système dans la production. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le leadership en génie et collaborerez avec les chercheurs en ML, les ingénieurs en données et les équipes de produits pour offrir une plateforme qui fournit des résultats concrets et horodatés aux évaluateurs humains à l'échelle.

Responsabilités
Architecture du moteur et propriété du système

• Concevoir et exploiter des services de sauvegarde évolutives pour l'ingestion des médias, le traitement et la production de rapports - propres, bien testés et construits pour l'échelle horizontale dès le premier jour

• Les propres contrats d'API, modèles de données et modèles de stockage pour les actifs des médias, les emplois de traitement, les extrants des modèles, les intégrations et les pistes de vérification

• Construisez des pipelines de traitement d'async à haut débit pour la vidéo, l'audio, l'image et le texte en utilisant des files d'attente et des modèles animés par des événements (SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub ou équivalent)

• Implémenter un traitement asynchrone fiable avec les retries, l'idempotency, les files d'attente en lettres mortes, la manipulation de la contre-pression et la dégradation gracieuse

Intégration AI/ML & flux de travail modèles

• Intégrer et optimiser les flux de travail d'inférence AI/ML au sein du moteur - intégrer des pipelines, des modèles multimodals, OCR, parole-texte, analyse de scène et classificateurs visuels

• Infrastructure propre au service du modèle : stratégies de batch, réglage de la concordance, comportement d'échauffement, manipulation du timeout, autoscalage et utilisation du GPU

• Appliquer des techniques pratiques d'optimisation des modèles - quantification, distillation, mise en lot, mise en cache, routage vers des modèles plus petits, le cas échéant - pour atteindre des cibles de latence, de débit et de coût sur du matériel limité

• Benchmark et d'évaluer les modèles candidats à l'aide de paramètres pertinents au domaine, pas seulement des classements standard. Établir des seuils d'exploitation en utilisant des méthodes d'étalonnage fondées sur les données et documenter la justification

Modèle de service et d'optimisation des performances

• Optimiser les flux de travail d'inférence AI/ML pour la latence, le débit, la fiabilité et le coût sur les voies de traitement en temps réel et par lots.

• Travailler avec des systèmes de serveur de modèles tels que vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, ou des services d'inférence personnalisées pour améliorer le batching, la concurrence, le comportement d'échauffement, la manipulation du timeout, le calibrage automatique et l'utilisation du GPU.

• Évaluer et appliquer des techniques pratiques d'optimisation des modèles comme la quantification, la distillation des modèles, le lotage, la mise en cache, l'optimisation rapide et l'acheminement vers des modèles plus petits ou moins chers, le cas échéant.

• Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes de recherche et d'indexation vectorielle à l'aide de technologies telles que Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elastic Vectors, FAISS, pgvector, ou d'outils similaires.

• Construire des workflows de recherche qui prennent en charge la recherche sémantique, l'appariement des similarités, la détection des duplications, la découverte des médias et la recherche structurée des métadonnées.

• Surveiller les performances du modèle et du système dans la production, y compris la latence des API, la profondeur de la file d'attente, le temps de traitement, les taux d'erreur du modèle, l'utilisation du GPU, les distributions de confiance, les signaux de dérive et le coût par article traité. Recherche, indexation et récupération de données

Infrastructure, fiabilité et observabilité

• Déployer et exploiter des systèmes sur des plates-formes de cloud AWS, GCP, Azure ou des plateformes de cloud équivalentes, y compris le calcul, le stockage, la mise en réseau, les files d'attente, l'infrastructure de serveur de modèles et les systèmes de surveillance.

• Assurer la fiabilité du système grâce à l'enregistrement, aux mesures, au traçage, à l'alerte, aux tableaux de bord, aux guides d'exécution opérationnels et aux pratiques exemplaires en matière de réponse aux incidents.

Collaboration et leadership en génie

• Mentor junior et mi-niveau des ingénieurs grâce à des examens de code, des discussions de conception et l'appariement pratique

• Conduire les décisions architecturales et améliorer la qualité de l'ingénierie à travers les travaux de backend, d'infrastructure et d'intégration ML

• Traduire les exigences ambiguës du produit en livrables techniques clairs avec des critères de succès définis

Ces trois capacités ne sont pas négociables . S'il vous plaît ne pas appliquer si vous ne pouvez pas parler aux trois avec des exemples spécifiques et des chiffres réels.

• Optimisation du modèle pour le matériel limité. Vous avez déployé un modèle ML (toute modalité) sur un serveur d'inférence à mémoire restreinte et amélioré ses performances en production. Vous avez une expérience pratique avec au moins deux de : quantification (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF, ou bitsandbytes), réglage de la stratégie de batching, optimisation KV-cache, distillation des connaissances, ou configuration de cadre de service (vLLM, Triton, TGI, ou équivalent). Vous pouvez citer des numéros précis avant/après la latence, le débit ou la mémoire de ce travail.

• Production de pipelines asynchrones. Vous êtes propriétaire d'un async media-processing ou d'un pipeline d'inférence ML de bout en bout - y compris la conception de la file d'attente, le traitement des défaillances des travailleurs, l'idempotency, la logique de réessayer, les files d'attente de lettres mortes et une couche d'observabilité. Vous comprenez ce qui se passe sous la contre-pression et ce qui casse en premier.

• Évaluation et rigueur d'étalonnage. Vous avez défini des seuils d'exploitation du modèle à l'aide de méthodes fondées sur les données - courbes de précision/rappel, mesures pondérées des coûts ou repères spécifiques au domaine - et non pas intuition, essai et erreur. Vous pouvez expliquer les compromis faux positifs et faux négatifs d'un classificateur en langage clair à un intervenant non technique.

Prescriptions supplémentaires:

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en ingénierie backend en construction de systèmes distribués évolutives, de pipelines de données ou de services de traitement des médias

• 4+ ans d'expérience pratique dans l'intégration de ML dans la production (APIs modèles, pipelines d'intégration, OCR, parole-texte, analyse vidéo/image ou inférence multimodale)

• Forte compétence Python; compréhension profonde de la conception RESTful API et des modèles de traitement async

• Expérience avec les bases de données SQL et NoSQL, la conception des schémas et la modélisation des données

• Expérience du déploiement et des systèmes d'exploitation sur AWS, GCP ou Azure

Préféré:

• Expérience des pipelines de traitement vidéo/image

• Familiarité avec les transformateurs HuggingFace, PyTorch et l'écosystème modèle open-source

• Travaux antérieurs sur la modération du contenu, la confiance et la sécurité, ou les systèmes de renseignement médiatique

• Expérience des modèles multilingues ou des pipelines de contenus multilingues

• Contributions à des projets de ML ou d'infrastructure en libre accès

Conception et architecture du système

• Compréhension privilégiée des systèmes distribués, des modèles d'échelle et de l'ingénierie de la performance

• Capacité à concevoir des architectures modulaires, durables et efficaces

• Expérience de la version API, de la modularisation et de la conception de workflows à long terme

• Compréhension des goulets d'étranglement de performance et des modèles de backend à faible latence

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally. The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology. Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile. Responsibilities Developer Advocacy & Community Building
• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.
• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.
• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.
• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities. Technical Content & Enablement
• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.
• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.
• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.
The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.
Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile.

Responsibilities
Developer Advocacy & Community Building

• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.

• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)

• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

Preferred

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.

• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency

• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.

• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.

• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Tether Wallet carries the Tether name, it is a self-custodial wallet used by people around the world to hold, send, and transact with USDt, XAUt, USAt, and BTC. We move fast, we ship to a global audience, and every release touches engineering, design, legal, compliance, licensing, expansion, marketing, and customer support before it goes out the door.
We're hiring a Project Manager to sit next to the Product Manager and own the process of getting features from spec to launch across every team that touches them.

Responsibilities
Your job is to make sure that once a feature is spec'd, it actually gets delivered on time, with every dependency handled, with no stakeholder left waiting on something they needed a week ago.

You'll be the person who:

• Stakeholders orchestration . Every Tether Wallet feature touches engineering, design, legal, compliance, licensing, expansion, marketing, and customer support. You're the single point of coordination across all of them, knowing what each team needs, when they need it, what they owe back, and how their work plugs into the release timeline. When something's off-track in any lane, you see it first and you act on it.

• Runs releases end-to-end. From sprint planning through QA, bug triage, legal sign-off, compliance review, support enablement, marketing coordination, and launch.

• Tracks every dependency across every stakeholder and surfaces risks before they become blockers.

• Followup with people. Stakeholders dragging their feet on a deliverable that's blocking a release is your problem to solve.

• Translates between technical and non-technical stakeholders . Engineering speaks one language, legal speaks another, marketing a third. You're the connective tissue.

• Owns the release tracker. Whatever shape it takes, Asana, status docs, weekly syncs, you keep the source of truth, even when stakeholders don't use your tools.

Mandatory

• 4+ years in project management, technical project management, scrum master, product owner, or delivery lead roles

• Engineering background. You've worked as a software engineer earlier in your career, or you hold a degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field. You understand system architecture, and hold a real technical conversation with engineers about scope, feasibility, and trade-offs

• Excellent communication skills , written and spoken. You can write a clear status update, run a focused meeting, send a crisp Slack message, and adapt your tone for engineers, lawyers, marketers, and executives

• Proven track record collaborating with diverse stakeholders. Orchestrating releases across engineering plus at least three non-engineering functions (legal, compliance, marketing, support, design, etc.)

• Hands-on experience building and owning release trackers and managing cross-team dependencies. You can explain to us a system you've built that tracked a real release across multiple teams, surfaced blockers early, and was actually used by the people involved

Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field (or
Soft Skills

• Highly charismatic communicator who can motivate teams, create buy-in, and move people to action without relying on formal authority.

• Exceptional leadership skills.

• Exceptional communication skills.

• Exceptional problem-solving skills.

Language: Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred

• Crypto experience in wallets, or exchanges

• Fintech or payment experience

• Background in a fast-moving consumer product (not just internal enterprise tools).

What you need to succeed
This is a role for someone with spine, presence, and ownership . The right person is:

• Decisive. When something needs a call, you make it. You don't wait to be asked twice.

• A source of authority. Stakeholders take you seriously because you're prepared, you follow through, and you don't flinch.

• Comfortable with ambiguity. Process won't always exist for what you're being asked to do. You'll design it on the fly, run it past the right people, and make it stick.

• Calm under volume. Fifty Slack notifications, a blocked release, and an angry stakeholder is a normal Tuesday

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
