Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n’est qu’un début : Tether Power : favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l’énergie excédentaire pour l’extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste Tether recherche un responsable de l'expansion de la blockchain pour mener des initiatives de croissance stratégique dans l'écosystème de partenaires blockchain de Tether. Ce rôle s'inscrit dans la fonction Blockchain Expansion et se concentre sur l'établissement et la gestion de relations à fort impact avec les fondations blockchain tout en exécutant des projets stratégiques qui élargissent l'adoption et l'utilité dans le monde réel des actifs Tether. Le Blockchain Expansion Manager travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires blockchain pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des initiatives qui augmentent de manière significative l’utilisation des actifs de Tether grâce à des cas d’utilisation pratiques et réels. Ce rôle nécessite de solides compétences en gestion de partenariats, une réflexion stratégique et la capacité d'exécuter des projets complexes avec plusieurs parties prenantes internes et externes. Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique adapté à quelqu'un qui s'épanouit dans un environnement en évolution rapide, opère avec autonomie et apporte structure et rigueur aux initiatives de croissance à fort impact. Responsabilités Gérer et approfondir les relations stratégiques avec les fondations blockchain et les partenaires de l'écosystème. Agir en tant que point de contact principal pour les partenaires blockchain assignés, en assurant l'alignement entre les objectifs des partenaires et les priorités stratégiques de Tether. Concevez et exécutez des projets de croissance à fort impact en collaboration avec des partenaires blockchain pour favoriser l'adoption des actifs Tether à travers des cas d'utilisation réels. Réfléchissez de manière stratégique à la manière dont Tether peut fonctionner avec les écosystèmes blockchain pour créer des projets évolutifs et durables qui élargissent l'utilisation et la circulation des actifs. Coordonner et gérer des initiatives interfonctionnelles impliquant l’expansion régionale, l’économie, le marketing et d’autres équipes internes. Suivre, gérer et rendre compte de l'avancement, des résultats et de l'efficacité du projet, en garantissant que les initiatives atteignent les objectifs définis. Identifiez les opportunités pour améliorer l’efficacité de l’exécution, la structure du projet et les résultats des partenaires. Travailler avec un haut degré d'autonomie, en prenant des initiatives pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités et les faire avancer. Soutenez le leadership interne avec des mises à jour claires, des informations et des recommandations basées sur les performances des partenaires et des projets. Expérience avérée obligatoire en partenariat ou en gestion d'écosystèmes, idéalement dans le domaine de la cryptographie, de la fintech ou de la technologie. Solide expérience dans la gestion de projets de croissance stratégique à fort impact, de la conception à l'exécution. Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et grand souci du détail. Capacité à suivre, gérer et optimiser plusieurs initiatives simultanément. Solides compétences en matière de réflexion stratégique et capacité de traduire des idées en projets exécutables. Expérience de travail interfonctionnel avec des équipes telles que l'expansion, l'économie, le marketing ou les produits. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, à prendre des initiatives et à opérer efficacement dans un environnement mondial distant. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais. Expérience préférée de travail avec des fondations blockchain ou des écosystèmes de couche 1/couche 2. Familiarité avec les pièces stables, l'infrastructure blockchain ou les cas d'utilisation réels de la blockchain. Expérience de travail dans des environnements à croissance rapide ou non structurés. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens via WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io. Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

titleByLocale.it: Operations Associate / Senior Associate-Finanza
titleByLocale.fr: Associé aux opérations / Associé principal - Finances

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Be part of our Finance team: The Operations Associate/Senior associate will support the day-to-day operations of a multi-asset investment and treasury platform , with responsibilities spanning trade operations, reconciliations, digital asset workflows, and process automation. The role requires a highly detail-oriented individual with strong technical capability and experience operating in fast-paced financial markets environments. Responsibilities ● Manage trade confirmations, settlements, and lifecycle events across multiple asset classes. ● Oversee wallet, custodian, and digital asset operational processes. ● Perform daily booking and reconciliation of securities positions, cash balances, and P&L across internal systems. ● Investigate and resolve trade breaks, settlement issues, and operational discrepancies with counterparties and custodians. ● Support operational controls relating to treasury, trading, and digital asset activities. ● Assist with audit requests, confirmations, and supporting documentation. ● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reporting. ● Build, enhance, and maintain operational workflows, internal tooling, and automation processes. ● Identify opportunities for process optimisation and operational scalability. ● Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and user guides. ● Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. Preferred qualifications/Requirements: ● Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field. ● 5+ years of operations experience preferably at a credit hedge fund. ● experience in digital assets or blockchain ecosystem(good to have but not mandatory) ● Proficiency in Enfusion portfolio management system (not mandatory) ● Proficiency in Excel + VBA / Python is mandatory. ● Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. ● Excellent attention to detail and communication skills. ● Strong understanding of trade lifecycles and settlement processes. ● Being able to work New York time: between (13H00 PM UK time -22H00 UK time) (mandatory) ● Being based in London (mandatory) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. --- Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT, basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. - Perché Unirsi a Noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? --- Il Ruolo: Senior Technical Product Manager per il QVAC SDK Descrizione del Ruolo L'obiettivo di Senior Technical Product Manager per QVAC SDK è quello di definire, guidare e scalare la strategia di prodotto rivolta agli sviluppatori per la piattaforma AI locale e distribuita di QVAC. Questo ruolo collega la profonda comprensione dell'ingegneria del software, la progettazione dell'esperienza dello sviluppatore, la comprensione del mercato e l'esecuzione del prodotto. Il QVAC SDK consente agli sviluppatori, alle imprese e ai partner ecosistemici di costruire applicazioni AI basate sulla privacy, on-device e peer-to-peer che funzionano efficacemente attraverso i dispositivi. La persona in questo ruolo possederà la visione del prodotto SDK, roadmap, flussi di lavoro degli sviluppatori, requisiti tecnici e strategia di adozione, lavorando a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria per trasformare l'infrastruttura AI complessa in strumenti di sviluppo chiari, utilizzabili e ben documentati. Questo è un ruolo altamente tecnico del prodotto che richiede capacità di codifica hands-on, forte giudizio intorno API e design SDK, e la capacità di prototipo, test e critica esperienza di sviluppo fluisce direttamente. Il candidato ideale ha costruito o gestito strumenti di sviluppo, SDKs, API, piattaforme AI o prodotti infrastrutturali, e può operare credibilmente con gli ingegneri senior, mentre comunicando anche il valore del prodotto a dirigenti, partner, acquirenti aziendali e sviluppatori esterni. L'obiettivo di un Technical Product Manager è quello di colmare il divario tra capacità tecniche e obiettivi aziendali, concentrandosi sugli aspetti tecnici dello sviluppo del prodotto. Lavorano a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneria per definire le roadmap dei prodotti, privilegiare le funzionalità basate sulla ricerca di mercato e sulle esigenze dei clienti, e garantire la consegna di prodotti e servizi tecnici. In questo modo, gestiscono la visione del prodotto, identificano e mitigano i potenziali rischi e mantengono l'allineamento con i requisiti aziendali globali. --- Mansioni - Product Vision & Strategy: Definire e valorizzare la visione del prodotto per il QVAC SDK, allineare le capacità tecniche con gli obiettivi più ampi di Tether in materia di AI locale, privacy, decentralizzazione e infrastruttura P2P. Identificare dove il SDK dovrebbe vincere attraverso gli sviluppatori di app di consumo, i team AI aziendali, i costruttori indipendenti e i partner ecosistemici. - SDK ProprietÃ: Possedere la roadmap per le capacitÃ SDK, API, flussi di lavoro degli sviluppatori, integrazioni, documentazione, esempi, modelli e strumenti. Priorizzare le funzionalità che rendono più facile per gli sviluppatori costruire, testare, distribuire e scalare le applicazioni AI locali utilizzando QVAC. - Sviluppatore Esperienza: Cura l'esperienza di sviluppo end-to-end, dalla prima installazione all'integrazione di produzione. Progettazione, mock up e convalidare i flussi DevX tra cui onboarding, configurazione SDK, utilizzo API, comportamento CLI, debugging flussi di lavoro, applicazioni campione, viaggi di documentazione e stati di errore. - Definizione del prodotto tecnico: Tradurre gli obiettivi del prodotto in precisi requisiti tecnici per i team di ingegneria. Definire il comportamento SDK, le superfici API, il supporto della piattaforma, i vincoli di modello/runtime, le aspettative delle prestazioni, i requisiti di privacy e i modelli di integrazione. - Hands-On Prototyping: Utilizzare la capacità di codifica per esplorare i flussi di lavoro SDK, costruire le integrazioni proof-of-concept, test API, esempi di revisione, valutare la documentazione e creare prototipi tecnici affidabili o mockup utilizzando strumenti come Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub, script locali, notebook o applicazioni leggere. - Partenariato di ingegneria: lavorare a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria porta a prendere decisioni di prodotto informate circa l'architettura SDK, l'esecuzione del modello, l'inferenza del bordo, le prestazioni, l'imballaggio, la compatibilità della piattaforma, la rete P2P e l'ergonomia dello sviluppatore. Sfida i presupposti costruttivamente e aiuta il team a bilanciare la velocità, l'usabilità, l'affidabilità e il debito tecnico. - Comprensione del mercato e del cliente: sviluppare una forte comprensione degli strumenti dello sviluppatore, dell'infrastruttura di AI, dell'intelligenza locale, dell'elaborazione dei bordi e dei mercati dell'intelligenza artificiale aziendale. Identificare le esigenze degli sviluppatori di applicazioni di consumo, dei clienti aziendali, dei ricercatori dell'IA e dei partner della piattaforma, e convertire tali intuizioni nelle priorità della roadmap. - Prioritizzazione: Priorizzare le capacità SDK basate sulla domanda dello sviluppatore, la fattibilità tecnica, il valore strategico, il potenziale di adozione e l'impatto commerciale misurabile. Utilizzare i dati, la ricerca degli utenti, l'analisi competitiva e il feedback diretto dello sviluppatore per guidare i trade-off. - Documentazione e Abilitazione: Partner con l'ingegneria, le relazioni con gli sviluppatori e il marketing per garantire che la SDK abbia una documentazione eccellente, esempi, tutorial, guide di migrazione, note di rilascio e materiali di lancio. Assicurare il contenuto tecnico è accurato, utilizzabile e allineato con flussi di lavoro reali dello sviluppatore. - Go-To-Market: Costruire e propri piani di lancio SDK in partnership con marketing, rapporti di sviluppo, ecosistema e team di business. Definire il posizionamento, target developer segmenti, moti di adozione, casi di utilizzo aziendale e opportunità di partner. - Performance e adozione Metrics: Definire e monitorare le metriche di successo SDK, tra cui l'attivazione, il tempo di primo successo, l'utilizzo API, il completamento dell'integrazione, la ritenzione, la soddisfazione dello sviluppatore, la qualità della documentazione, il tempo di risoluzione dei problemi, i benchmark delle prestazioni e l'adozione dell'impresa. - Stakeholder Communication: Comunicare chiaramente con dirigenti, ingegneri, partner, clienti aziendali e sviluppatori. Spiegare concetti complessi di AI, SDK e infrastrutture in modi che supportano il processo decisionale, l'allineamento e l'adozione. --- Obbligatori - 8+ anni di gestione dei prodotti, gestione dei prodotti tecnici, ingegneria del software, strumenti di sviluppo, piattaforma, SDK, API, infrastruttura AI o relativa esperienza. - Forte sfondo di sviluppo software con capacità di codifica hands-on. Il candidato non ha bisogno di essere un ingegnere a tempo pieno oggi, ma deve essere in grado di leggere il codice, scrivere prototipi, testare i flussi SDK, capire il design API e impegnarsi profondamente con i trade-off di ingegneria. - Esperienza con i framework AI locali o runtime come llama.cpp, TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, ONNX Runtime, MLX, WebGPU, WebNN, o tecnologie simili. - Priore esperienza di costruzione, gestione o lancio di prodotti di sviluppo-facing come SDKs, APIs, CLIs, frameworks, piattaforme, strumenti infrastrutturali, AI tooling, o integrazioni tecniche. - Forte comprensione dei principi dell'esperienza dello sviluppatore, inclusi i percorsi di bordo, documentazione, ergonomia API, gestione degli errori, debug, esempi, modelli e percorsi di integrazione. - La comprensione tecnica dei sistemi AI/ML, in particolare l'inferenza locale, l'ottimizzazione dei modelli, i vincoli di runtime, l'elaborazione dei bordi, la tutela della privacy dell'intelligenza artificiale e gli scambi di prestazioni. - Capacità di tradurre esigenze di mercato e feedback degli sviluppatori in requisiti di prodotto chiari, priorità roadmap e risultati misurabili. - Esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneria su prodotti tecnici complessi, tra cui discussioni di architettura, pianificazione del rilascio, analisi di trade-off e gestione del debito tecnico. - Capacità di creare mockup, wireframe, prototipi, diagrammi tecnici, flussi di lavoro campione, o prove basate su codice di concetto per allineare le parti interessate e chiarire la direzione del prodotto. - Forte comprensione dei mercati del software di consumo e di impresa, tra cui come gli sviluppatori valutano, adottano e scalano SDK o piattaforme. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, compresa la capacità di spiegare concetti tecnici complessi a stakeholder non tecnici e implicazioni aziendali a team tecnici. - Provato record di prodotti tecnici di spedizione con adozione misurabile, soddisfazione dello sviluppatore, o impatto aziendale. - Giudizio del prodotto forte, competenze di prioritizzazione e pregiudizio per l'esecuzione in ambienti ambigui e veloci. - Familiarità con lo sviluppo agile, analisi dei prodotti, ricerca degli sviluppatori, analisi competitiva e processi di documentazione tecnica. - Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Business, o un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente. --- Preferiti - Esperienza con blockchain, rete P2P, sistemi decentralizzati, calcolo distribuito, o l'infrastruttura di conservazione della privacy. - Esperienza con SDKs in ambienti mobili, desktop, web, backend o incorporati. - Familiarità con TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin, C/C++, Rust, Go, o lingue simili. - Esperienza con piattaforme di sviluppo enterprise, infrastrutture B2B SaaS, piattaforme AI o movimenti di crescita guidati dallo sviluppatore. - Esperienza con progettazione API, versione semantica, gestione dei pacchetti, canali di rilascio, garanzie di compatibilità e pianificazione della migrazione. - Esperienza di condurre colloqui di sviluppatori, test di usabilità, workshop tecnici, hackathons, o la scoperta del cliente aziendale. - Familiarità con le normative sulla privacy dei dati come GDPR e CCPA in relazione ai prodotti AI e alle piattaforme di sviluppo. --- Informazioni Importanti per i Candidati - Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non serve reclutamento di terze parti o agenzie a meno che non sia esplicitamente indicato. Tutte le posizioni aperte sono elencate sulla nostra pagina ufficiale delle carriere: https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Verifica l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se non sicuro sei, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il profilo o contattandoci tramite il nostro sito web. - Sii prudente nei metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non favoramo interviste tramite WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni avvengono tramite email ufficiali e piattaforme aziendali. - Controlla gli indirizzi. Tutte le comunicazioni da parte nostra influenza da email che terminano con @tether.to o @tether.io. - Non chiederemo mai pagamenti o informazioni finanziarie. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o pagamenti in qualsiasi momento

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The goal of the Senior Technical Product Manager for the QVAC SDK is to define, guide, and scale the developer-facing product strategy for QVAC’s local and distributed AI platform. This role bridges deep software engineering understanding, developer experience design, market insight, and product execution. The QVAC SDK enables developers, enterprises, and ecosystem partners to build privacy-preserving, on-device, and peer-to-peer AI applications that run efficiently across devices. The person in this role will own the SDK product vision, roadmap, developer workflows, technical requirements, and adoption strategy, working closely with engineering to turn complex AI infrastructure into clear, usable, well-documented developer tools. This is a highly technical product role requiring hands-on coding ability, strong judgment around APIs and SDK design, and the ability to prototype, test, and critique developer experience flows directly. The ideal candidate has built or managed developer tools, SDKs, APIs, AI platforms, or infrastructure products, and can operate credibly with senior engineers while also communicating product value to executives, partners, enterprise buyers, and external developers. The goal of a Technical Product Manager is to bridge the gap between technical capabilities and business objectives, focusing on the technical aspects of product development. They work closely with engineering teams to define product roadmaps, prioritize features based on market research and customer needs, and ensure the successful delivery of technical products and services. In doing so, they manage the product vision, identify and mitigate potential risks, and maintain alignment with overall business requirements. Responsibilities
• Product Vision & Strategy: Define and champion the product vision for the QVAC SDK, aligning technical capabilities with Tether’s broader objectives around local AI, privacy, decentralization, and P2P infrastructure. Identify where the SDK should win across consumer app developers, enterprise AI teams, independent builders, and ecosystem partners.
• SDK Ownership: Own the roadmap for SDK capabilities, APIs, developer workflows, integrations, documentation, examples, templates, and tooling. Prioritize features that make it easier for developers to build, test, deploy, and scale Local AI applications using QVAC.
• Developer Experience: Curate the end-to-end developer experience, from first install to production integration. Design, mock up, and validate DevX flows including onboarding, SDK setup, API usage, CLI behavior, debugging workflows, sample apps, documentation journeys, and error states.
• Technical Product Definition: Translate product goals into precise technical requirements for engineering teams. Define SDK behavior, API surfaces, platform support, model/runtime constraints, performance expectations, privacy requirements, and integration patterns.
• Hands-On Prototyping: Use coding ability to explore SDK workflows, build proof-of-concept integrations, test APIs, review examples, evaluate documentation, and create credible technical prototypes or mockups using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub, local scripts, notebooks, or lightweight apps.
• Engineering Partnership: Work closely with engineering leads to make informed product decisions around SDK architecture, model execution, edge inference, performance, packaging, platform compatibility, P2P networking, and developer ergonomics. Challenge assumptions constructively and help the team balance speed, usability, reliability, and technical debt.
• Market and Customer Understanding: Develop a strong understanding of the developer tools, AI infrastructure, Local AI, edge computing, and enterprise AI markets. Identify the needs of consumer application developers, enterprise customers, AI researchers, and platform partners, and convert those insights into roadmap priorities.
• Feature Prioritization: Prioritize SDK capabilities based on developer demand, technical feasibility, strategic value, adoption potential, and measurable business impact. Use data, user research, competitive analysis, and direct developer feedback to guide trade-offs.
• Documentation and Enablement: Partner with engineering, developer relations, and marketing to ensure the SDK has excellent documentation, examples, tutorials, migration guides, release notes, and launch materials. Ensure technical content is accurate, usable, and aligned with real developer workflows.
• Go-To-Market: Build and own SDK launch plans in partnership with marketing, developer relations, ecosystem, and business teams. Define positioning, target developer segments, adoption motions, enterprise use cases, and partner opportunities.
• Performance and Adoption Metrics: Define and track SDK success metrics, including activation, time-to-first-success, API usage, integration completion, retention, developer satisfaction, documentation quality, issue resolution time, performance benchmarks, and enterprise adoption.
• Stakeholder Communication: Communicate clearly with executives, engineers, partners, enterprise customers, and developers. Explain complex AI, SDK, and infrastructure concepts in ways that support decision-making, alignment, and adoption. Mandatory:
• 8+ years of product management, technical product management, software engineering, developer tools, platform, SDK, API, AI infrastructure, or related experience.
• Strong software development background with hands-on coding ability. The candidate does not need to be a full-time engineer today, but must be able to read code, write prototypes, test SDK flows, understand API design, and engage deeply with engineering trade-offs.
• Experience with Local AI frameworks or runtimes such as llama.cpp, TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, ONNX Runtime, MLX, WebGPU, WebNN, or similar technologies.
• Prior experience building, managing, or launching developer-facing products such as SDKs, APIs, CLIs, frameworks, platforms, infrastructure tools, AI tooling, or technical integrations.
• Strong understanding of developer experience principles, including onboarding, documentation, API ergonomics, error handling, debugging workflows, examples, templates, and integration paths.
• Technical understanding of AI/ML systems, especially local inference, model optimization, runtime constraints, edge computing, privacy-preserving AI, and performance trade-offs.
• Ability to translate market needs and developer feedback into clear product requirements, roadmap priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Experience working closely with engineering teams on complex technical products, including architecture discussions, release planning, trade-off analysis, and technical debt management.
• Ability to create mockups, wireframes, prototypes, technical diagrams, sample workflows, or code-based proofs of concept to align stakeholders and clarify product direction.
• Strong understanding of consumer and enterprise software markets, including how developers evaluate, adopt, and scale SDKs or platforms.
• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and business implications to technical teams.
• Proven track record of shipping technical products with measurable adoption, developer satisfaction, or business impact.
• Strong product judgment, prioritization skills, and bias for execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Familiarity with agile development, product analytics, developer research, competitive analysis, and technical documentation processes.
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred:
• Experience with blockchain, P2P networking, decentralized systems, distributed computing, or privacy-preserving infrastructure.
• Experience with SDKs across mobile, desktop, web, backend, or embedded environments.
• Familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin, C/C++, Rust, Go, or similar languages.
• Experience with enterprise developer platforms, B2B SaaS infrastructure, AI platforms, or developer-led growth motions.
• Experience with API design, semantic versioning, package management, release channels, compatibility guarantees, and migration planning.
• Experience conducting developer interviews, usability testing, technical workshops, hackathons, or enterprise customer discovery.
• Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA as they relate to AI products and developer platforms. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Descrizione Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. --- Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques. Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales grâce à des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education: Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous habilitons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités. Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Unirsi a Noi ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? --- Il Ruolo: Senior Technical Product Manager per il QVAC SDK Descrizione del Ruolo L'objectif du Senior Technical Product Manager pour le SDK QVAC est de définir, guider et mettre à l'échelle la stratégie de produit orientée vers le développeur pour la plateforme locale et distribuée de QVAC. Ce rôle relie la compréhension profonde de l'ingénierie logicielle, la conception d'expérience de développeur, la perspicacité du marché et l'exécution de produits. Le SDK QVAC permet aux développeurs, aux entreprises et aux partenaires de l'écosystème de construire des applications d'intelligence artificielle de préservation de la vie privée, sur les appareils et de pair à pair qui fonctionnent efficacement sur les appareils. La personne dans ce rôle sera propriétaire de la vision de produit SDK, feuille de route, workflows de développeur, exigences techniques, et stratégie d'adoption, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie pour transformer une infrastructure d'IA complexe en outils de développeur clairs, utilisables et bien documentés. Il s'agit d'un rôle de produit hautement technique nécessitant une capacité de codage pratique, un jugement fort sur les API et la conception de SDK, et la capacité de prototyper, de tester et de critiquer l'expérience du développeur circule directement. Le candidat idéal a construit ou géré des outils de développeur, SDK, API, plates-formes d'IA, ou des produits d'infrastructure, et peut fonctionner de façon crédible avec des ingénieurs seniors tout en communiquant la valeur du produit aux cadres, partenaires, acheteurs d'entreprise et développeurs externes. L'objectif d'un gestionnaire de produits techniques est de combler l'écart entre les capacités techniques et les objectifs opérationnels, en mettant l'accent sur les aspects techniques du développement de produits. Ils travaillent en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie pour définir les feuilles de route des produits, hiérarchiser les caractéristiques en fonction de l'étude de marché et des besoins des clients et assurer la prestation réussie des produits et services techniques. Ce faisant, ils gèrent la vision du produit, identifient et atténuent les risques potentiels et maintiennent l'alignement sur les exigences opérationnelles générales. --- Mansioni - Vision et stratégie du produit : Définir et défendre la vision du produit pour le SDK QVAC, en alignant les capacités techniques avec les objectifs plus larges de Tether en matière d'IA locale, de confidentialité, de décentralisation et d'infrastructure P2P. Déterminer où le SDK devrait gagner parmi les développeurs d'applications grand public, les équipes d'IA d'entreprise, les constructeurs indépendants et les partenaires écosystémiques. - Propriété de SDK : Posséder la feuille de route pour les capacités de SDK, les API, les flux de travail des développeurs, les intégrations, la documentation, les exemples, les modèles et l'outillage. Privilégier les fonctionnalités qui facilitent la construction, l'essai, le déploiement et l'échelle des applications d'IA locales en utilisant QVAC. - Expérience du développeur : Prévoyez l'expérience du développeur de bout en bout, de la première installation à l'intégration de la production. Concevoir, simuler et valider les flux DevX, y compris l'embarquement, la configuration SDK, l'utilisation de l'API, le comportement CLI, le débogage des workflows, les exemples d'applications, les parcours de documentation et les états d'erreur. - Définition technique du produit: Traduire les objectifs du produit en exigences techniques précises pour les équipes d'ingénierie. Définir le comportement SDK, les surfaces de l'API, le support de la plate-forme, les contraintes de modèle/d'exécution, les attentes en matière de performance, les exigences en matière de confidentialité et les modèles d'intégration. - Hands-On Prototyping: Utilisez la capacité de codage pour explorer les flux de travail SDK, construire des intégrations d'épreuve de concept, tester des API, examiner des exemples, évaluer la documentation, et créer des prototypes techniques crédibles ou des maquettes à l'aide d'outils tels que Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub, scripts locaux, cahiers ou applications légères. - Engineering Partnership: Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie conduit à prendre des décisions éclairées sur l'architecture SDK, l'exécution de modèles, l'inférence de bord, les performances, l'emballage, la compatibilité de plate-forme, le réseau P2P et l'ergonomie du développeur. Défier les hypothèses de façon constructive et aider l'équipe à équilibrer la vitesse, la facilité d'utilisation, la fiabilité et la dette technique. - Compréhension du marché et de la clientèle : Développer une bonne compréhension des outils de développement, de l'infrastructure de l'IA, de l'IA locale, de l'informatique de pointe et des marchés de l'IA d'entreprise. Identifier les besoins des développeurs d'applications pour les consommateurs, des clients d'entreprise, des chercheurs sur l'IA et des partenaires de la plateforme, et convertir ces idées en priorités de feuille de route. - Priorisation des fonctions : Prioriser les capacités SDK en fonction de la demande du développeur, de la faisabilité technique, de la valeur stratégique, du potentiel d'adoption et de l'impact opérationnel mesurable. Utiliser les données, la recherche des utilisateurs, l'analyse concurrentielle et diriger la rétroaction des développeurs pour guider les compromis. - Documentation et activation: Partenaire avec l'ingénierie, les relations des développeurs et le marketing pour s'assurer que le SDK possède une documentation excellente, des exemples, des tutoriels, des guides de migration, des notes de sortie et du matériel de lancement. Assurez-vous que le contenu technique est précis, utilisable et aligné sur les flux de travail réels des développeurs. - Go-To-Market: Construisez et possédez des plans de lancement SDK en partenariat avec le marketing, les relations avec les développeurs, les écosystèmes et les équipes d'affaires. Définir le positionnement, les segments de développeurs cibles, les mouvements d'adoption, les cas d'utilisation d'entreprise et les opportunités de partenaires. - Mesure des performances et de l'adoption : Définir et suivre les mesures de succès SDK, y compris l'activation, le temps écoulé jusqu'au premier succès, l'utilisation de l'API, l'achèvement de l'intégration, la conservation, la satisfaction du développeur, la qualité de la documentation, le temps de résolution des problèmes, les repères de performance et l'adoption d'entreprise. - Communication des parties prenantes : Communiquer clairement avec les cadres, les ingénieurs, les partenaires, les clients d'entreprise et les développeurs. Expliquer les concepts complexes d'IA, de SDK et d'infrastructure de façon à appuyer la prise de décisions, l'alignement et l'adoption. ---
• Requisiti
• Requisiti Obbligatori - 8+ ans de gestion de produits, gestion technique de produits, ingénierie logicielle, outils de développement, plate-forme, SDK, API, infrastructure AI, ou expérience connexe. - Forte expérience de développement de logiciels avec une capacité de codage pratique. Le candidat n'a pas besoin d'être ingénieur à temps plein aujourd'hui, mais doit être capable de lire le code, d'écrire des prototypes, de tester les flux SDK, de comprendre la conception de l'API et de s'engager profondément dans des compromis techniques. - Expérience des frameworks ou des runtimes d'IA locaux tels que lama.cpp, TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, ONNX Runtime, MLX, WebGPU, WebNN ou des technologies similaires. - Concevoir, gérer ou lancer des produits destinés aux développeurs tels que SDK, API, CLI, frameworks, plates-formes, outils d'infrastructure, outillage d'IA ou intégrations techniques. - Bonne compréhension des principes de l'expérience du développeur, y compris l'embarquement, la documentation, l'ergonomie de l'API, le traitement des erreurs, le débogage des workflows, des exemples, des modèles et des chemins d'intégration. - Compréhension technique des systèmes AI/ML, en particulier l'inférence locale, l'optimisation des modèles, les contraintes d'exécution, l'informatique de bord, la protection de la vie privée et les compromis de performance. - Capacité de traduire les besoins du marché et la rétroaction du développeur en exigences claires de produits, en priorités de feuille de route et en résultats mesurables. - Expérience de la collaboration étroite avec les équipes d'ingénierie sur les produits techniques complexes, y compris les discussions sur l'architecture, la planification des rejets, l'analyse des compromis et la gestion technique de la dette. - Capacité de créer des maquettes, des trames filaires, des prototypes, des diagrammes techniques, des exemples de flux de travail ou des preuves de concept fondées sur des codes pour harmoniser les intervenants et clarifier l'orientation du produit. - Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations. Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.
• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.
• Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.
• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.
• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.
• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.
• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements. Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.
• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.
• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.
• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.
• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.
• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.
• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.
• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.
• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments. Preferred / Advantageous
• Prior experience operating in Central America.
• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.
• Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are looking for an automation-driven and hands-on People Technology Analyst whose primary mission will be to review, streamline, and automate our global People Operations processes. In this role, you will audit our existing workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and leverage our HR tech stack to build highly efficient, automated solutions while elevating our People Analytics capabilities. The ideal candidate has a passion for operational efficiency, an analytical mindset, and a proven track record of transforming fragmented, manual tasks into scalable, automated workflows that improve the overall employee and team experience. Responsibilities
• Workflow Audit & Process Automation: Continuously map, review, and audit existing People Operations processes (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, contract changes, data updates) to identify inefficiencies. Design and implement automation strategies to eliminate manual tasks and friction points.
• HR Tech Stack Optimization: Act as the main system administrator for our HRIS (HiBob) and associated tools. Configure advanced automated workflows, custom triggers, alerts, and approvals to ensure seamless operations across global teams.
• System Integrations & Data Syncing: Oversee and optimize api-driven or native integrations between our HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), and Finance tools (Payhawk) and others such Slack, Confluence and Harvest. Ensure data flows automatically and securely between platforms without requiring manual data entry.
• Data Governance & Analytics: Establish automated data validation rules to protect data integrity. Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reports (tracking headcount, turnover, and talent acquisition metrics) to deliver real-time, actionable insights.
• Continuous Improvement & Scale: Stay ahead of HR technology trends and new feature releases within our existing tools (specifically HiBob updates) to proactively suggest and implement process improvements.
• User Enablement & Documentation: Create clear documentation for newly automated processes to ensure high adoption rates and self-sufficiency across the organization.
• Proven HR Tech Experience: 3+ years of experience managing, configuring, and deploying workflows in HRIS/ATS platforms within fast-growing or international environments.
• Process Optimization & Automation Mindset: Proven experience in business process mapping, workflow redesign, and implementing automation logic within HR ecosystems.
• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Direct experience configuring platform architecture, complex automated approval chains, and multi-conditional workflows in HiBob and Recruitee (or similar tools). HiBob experience will be a strong advantage.
• Data & Analytics Mastery: Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) to track process efficiency and HR metrics.
• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Deep understanding of how software systems interact, including integration logic (APIs) and data mapping.
• Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

titleByLocale.it: Bare Sviluppatore (100% Remote - Worldwide)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices. Native module development
• Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests
• Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript
• Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list Cross-platform builds and CI
• Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)
• Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform
• Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms
• Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues Bare Runtime contributions
• Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads)
• Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface
• Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry Debugging and quality
• Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile
• Write and maintain tests for all modules Collaboration and communication
• Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public.
• Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing .
• Participate in a weekly status call.
• Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials.
• Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet).
• Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms.
• Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of Node.js internals and the module ecosystem.
• Experience building native addons for Node.js or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent).
• Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks.
• Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains.
• Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem).
• Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases.
• Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills.

About the job As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, the Solutions Partner Manager is responsible for managing, enabling, and governing a network of consulting firms, system integrators, and delivery partners who implement Tether products (WDK, QVAC, and MOS). The role ensures partners deliver high-quality projects, align with Tether’s interests, meet certification standards, and drive customer satisfaction. Responsibilities 1. Partner Relationship & Capability Management
• Act as the primary relationship owner for all Solutions Partners.
• Coordinate the assessment of partner capabilities, delivery maturity, and resources.
• Ensure partners maintain sufficient certified consultants and technical capacity.
• Conduct regular capability reviews and develop partner improvement plans as needed. 2. Partner Onboarding & Certification
• Lead the onboarding of new implementation partners, including due diligence and contract execution.
• Coordinate partner training and certification programs
• Ensure adherence to implementation playbooks, best practices, and delivery frameworks. 3. Delivery Governance
• Oversee partner-led implementations to ensure alignment with methodology, quality standards, and timelines.
• Participate in project kick-offs, milestone reviews, and governance checkpoints.
• Validate partner deliverables (e.g., configurations, integration setups, testing documentation).
• Manage escalations and coordinate resolutions with internal Technical, Support, and Product teams. 4. Project Portfolio Monitoring
• Maintain visibility over the entire portfolio of partner-led projects.
• Identify and flag cross-sell opportunities with other Tether products or with services offered by Tether portfolio companies, where relevant.
• Track delivery risks, resourcing gaps, and escalations across the partner ecosystem.
• Ensure Partners receive Technical support as required during their implementations 5. Quality Assurance & Performance Management
• Monitor KPIs such as project success rate, CSAT, and partner delivery quality.
• Perform quarterly partner performance reviews.
• Define corrective action plans or temporary delivery restrictions when required.
• Manage re-certification cycles and partner tiering. 7. Cross-Functional Coordination
• Work closely with Customer Success, Delivery, Support, Product, and Training teams.
• Ensure smooth transitions between sales-to-delivery and delivery-to-support phases.
• Provide feedback from partner projects to internal teams to improve product quality and implementation processes. 8. Partner Lifecycle Management
• Manage partner renewal, re-certification, and (if necessary) offboarding.
• Maintain partner records, capability matrices, and project performance logs.
• 4–8 years in Partner Management, Delivery Management, Professional Services, or Project Governance roles.
• Experience working with implementation partners, system integrators, or consulting firms.
• Strong understanding of software/IT implementation processes (integration, configuration, change management, UAT, go-live).
• Collaborate with world-class technical and business teams across multiple regions.
• Experience in SaaS, fintech, AI, blockchain, digital content platforms, or enterprise open source software.
• Previous work with partner-led delivery models or certification programs.
• Knowledge of partner governance tools, PMO frameworks, and QA processes.
• English is a must, any other language a plus Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job The Associate, Asset Management Reporting is part of Tether’s asset management function, supporting portfolio-level reporting and performance analytics across a global, multi-billion, multi-asset investment portfolio. The role operates at the intersection of investment, finance, and reporting, contributing to structured performance visibility and disciplined reporting standards across the platform. Working closely with senior members of the asset management team, the Analyst / Associate helps consolidate data, produce analytical insights, and ensure high-quality reporting for senior leadership. The position is open to candidates at both analyst and associate level , depending on experience. Key Responsibilities:
• Support preparation of recurring portfolio performance reports and leadership materials.
• Consolidate financial and operational data from investment teams into structured reporting formats.
• Maintain and update reporting dashboards, performance trackers, and analytics tools.
• Perform variance analysis, trend identification, and commentary on portfolio-level developments.
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness across reporting outputs.
• Assist in preparation of materials for internal governance and committee processes.
• Contribute to enhancement of reporting frameworks and performance monitoring standards. Preferred Qualifications/Requirements:
• 2–7 years of experience in asset management, portfolio reporting, performance analytics, finance, or a related analytical role.
• Strong analytical skills with comfort handling complex data sets and recurring reporting cycles.
• Experience preparing structured reporting materials for senior stakeholders.
• High proficiency in Excel and presentation tools; familiarity with reporting systems or BI tools is a plus.
• Detail-oriented, structured, and execution-focused with a strong sense of ownership.
• Ability to coordinate across teams and communicate clearly in a global, fast-paced environment.

The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences. You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features . You will also contribute to backend components when needed to support mobile features and unblock mobile delivery. You will also provide technical leadership , guide mobile engineering best practices, and support other engineers through reviews and mentoring. Responsibilities
• Leadership: Lead a small group of React Native engineers. Drive architectural decisions, enforce coding standards, and ensure timely high quality delivery.
• Development: Design and build advanced cross platform applications for the iOS and Android platforms using React Native, review work from other engineers to ensure quality and architectural alignment, and contribute to backend services or APIs when required to support mobile functionality.
• Integration: Work closely with backend developers, integrate Javascript SDKs, libraries, and backend services into mobile applications, and extend backend logic when needed to complete end-to-end features.
• Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver innovative solutions.
• Architecture: Own and define patterns for state management, navigation, performance, modularization, and security across mobile applications. Mandatory
• Thoroughly experienced with React, React-Native (mainly around Expo), Redux and the core principles surrounding these.
• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ .
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools .
• Experienced with Native modules (C++) , WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
• Experience in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android) for low level implementation.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring mobile engineers .
• Demonstrated ability to own architecture for large scale React Native applications .
• Strong decision making skills in evaluating frameworks, tooling, and mobile development patterns.

Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences. You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features . You will also contribute to backend components when needed to support mobile features and unblock mobile delivery. You will also provide technical leadership , guide mobile engineering best practices, and support other engineers through reviews and mentoring. Responsibilities
• Leadership: Lead a small group of React Native engineers. Drive architectural decisions, enforce coding standards, and ensure timely high quality delivery.
• Development: Design and build advanced cross platform applications for the iOS and Android platforms using React Native, review work from other engineers to ensure quality and architectural alignment, and contribute to backend services or APIs when required to support mobile functionality.
• Integration: Work closely with backend developers, integrate Javascript SDKs, libraries, and backend services into mobile applications, and extend backend logic when needed to complete end-to-end features.
• Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver innovative solutions.
• Architecture: Own and define patterns for state management, navigation, performance, modularization, and security across mobile applications. Mandatory
• Thoroughly experienced with React, React-Native (mainly around Expo), Redux and the core principles surrounding these.
• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ .
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools .
• Experienced with Native modules (C++) , WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
• Experience in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android) for low level implementation.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring mobile engineers .
• Demonstrated ability to own architecture for large scale React Native applications .
• Strong decision making skills in evaluating frameworks, tooling, and mobile development patterns.
• Experience with b ackend development using Node or similar environments , with the ability to implement or adjust APIs and services that power mobile features.
• Comfortable working across the stack when required, while still maintaining strong depth in mobile development. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
